title: DA-Studio: An Agentic System for End-to-End Data Analysis
summary: Real-world data analysis is a multi-step process over heterogeneous inputs rather than merely producing a final answer. A practical system should autonomously organize multi-step workflows, execute generated code in a sandboxed and controllable environment, and remain inspectable through visible action traces and intermediate artifacts. Existing LLM-based analysis tools, however, often emphasize isolated subtasks, leaving limited support for complete execution-grounded workflows. We present DA-Studio (Data Analysis Studio), an interactive web-based demo system for end-to-end data analysis that is autonomous, sandboxed, and inspectable. DA-Studio integrates an action-structured analysis backend, a sandboxed execution workspace, and a browser interface for task setup, streamed action traces, artifact preview, code editing and rerunning, and report export. Through iterative action generation, code execution, and feedback incorporation, it incrementally constructs executable analysis steps from raw files and natural-language requests while exposing intermediate results and artifacts throughout the process.

AI.tldr: DA-Studio 是一个面向端到端数据分析的智能体（Agentic）交互式 Web 演示系统，具备自主性、沙箱化执行和可审查三大特性。它通过动作结构化的分析后端、沙箱化执行环境和浏览器界面，将原始文件与自然语言请求逐步转化为可执行的分析步骤，并全程暴露中间动作轨迹与产物。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的数据分析是多步骤、异构输入的过程，而非仅产生最终答案。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的分析工具（如 LIDA、Data Formulator 2、nvAgent）主要聚焦于可视化生成或孤立的子任务，缺乏对完整执行落地（execution-grounded）工作流的支持。领域专家在将原始文件转化为可执行分析步骤和最终交付物的过程中仍需大量手动操作，因此需要一个能自主编排多步骤工作流、在沙箱中执行生成代码、并通过可见的动作轨迹和中间产物实现可审查的端到端系统。
AI.method: DA-Studio 采用五层架构并通过三个功能视图来组织系统：1) 应用层（Application Layer）：管理用户请求、流式输出和会话工作区状态，支持任务配置、结构化动作块、代码片段、执行反馈的增量渲染，以及代码编辑、重跑和报告导出等后执行干预；2) 模型层（Model Layer）：采用统一的动作协议（action protocol），模型按需选择规划（<Analyze>）、数据理解（<Understand>）、代码生成（<Code>）、执行（<Execute>）、答案生成（<Answer>）等动作，并通过模型兼容层支持 DeepAnalyze 等专用模型和通用 LLM；3) 上下文层（Context Layer）：采用面向数据的上下文构建策略，将任务指令和轻量级文件描述符组织为结构化提示，模型按需通过代码执行检索相关内容，并维护滚动会话状态以实现"生成-执行-反馈"循环；4) 数据层（Data Layer）：通过会话作用域工作区抽象管理上传输入和生成输出，使用路径安全 API 解析文件操作，并通过工件索引区分用户输入与系统生成的衍生品；5) 环境层（Environment Layer）：在基于 Docker 的沙箱中执行生成的代码，采用会话导向的温调度（warm scheduling）策略——同一会话复用温容器，不同会话映射到不同容器，空闲容器超时回收，执行前后通过工作区快照检测新增或修改文件并注册为生成工件。
AI.result: DA-Studio 作为一个交互式 Web 演示系统，实现了对多文件异构输入的执行落地数据分析支持。通过一个商户支付分析任务的演示场景，展示了完整的工作流程：（1）任务设置（上传 payments.csv、fees.json、manual.md 等多格式数据集并输入自然语言分析请求）；（2）跟随分析展开（流式展示 <Analyze>→<Code>→<Execute>→<Understand> 的迭代过程）；（3）检查中间产物（在右侧工作区实时预览上传文件和生成的表格、图表、执行摘要）；（4）修改和重跑生成的代码（通过自然语言修改指令或直接编辑代码，在同一沙箱工作区中重跑脚本）；（5）导出最终结果和分析轨迹（以 Markdown/PDF 形式导出报告，并以打包归档形式下载生成的工件）。系统源代码、数据及其他工件已在 GitHub 开源。
AI.conclusion: DA-Studio 做出了三项贡献：第一，通过动作结构化的后端支持自主的、执行落地的多步骤分析；第二，通过会话作用域工作区和工件管理提供沙箱化执行，支持可复现的分析和重跑；第三，提供了一个统一的浏览器界面，集成了数据上传、流式轨迹、工件预览、代码修改和报告导出，实现了可审查的端到端数据分析。该系统将自主性、沙箱化执行和可审查性统一在一个交互式 Web 演示系统中，使用户能够从原始文件和自然语言目标出发，跟随执行落地的分析过程，检查工件，修改代码，并导出输出。

title: Clean Me If You Can: A Large Collection of Real-World Addresses for Data Cleaning Benchmarking
summary: There has been extensive research on automating and scaling data cleaning, i.e., the detection and correction of erroneous values in tabular data. Yet, existing approaches often perform well only within controlled environments. One of the major bottlenecks in data cleaning research is the lack of real-world datasets. In this paper, we address this gap by providing a large, dirty dataset with postal entries and their corresponding ground truth. We discuss the design decisions and challenges for obtaining the dataset. We demonstrate the limitations of existing cleaning approaches when faced with our proposed datasets and derive guidelines for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文针对数据清洗研究中缺乏真实世界数据集的问题，发布了一个大规模的、含噪声的邮政地址数据集及其对应的真实标签（ground truth），并通过实验揭示了现有数据清洗方法在该真实数据集上的局限性，为未来研究提供了指导。
AI.motivation: 数据清洗（检测与修正表格数据中的错误值）的研究虽广泛，但现有方法多在受控环境下表现良好，泛化能力不足。其核心瓶颈在于缺乏真实世界（real-world）的大规模脏数据集，导致研究难以贴近实际应用场景、无法有效评估方法的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 作者构建并发布了一个大规模的真实世界邮政地址（postal entries）脏数据集，并配套提供对应的真实标签。其方法包括：（1）讨论数据集收集过程中的设计决策（design decisions）与挑战；（2）通过在该数据集上运行现有的数据清洗方法，进行基准测试（benchmark）以评估其表现。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，现有数据清洗方法在面对该真实邮政地址数据集时表现出明显的局限性（limitations），无法很好地泛化或处理真实场景中的数据质量问题。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集填补了数据清洗领域缺乏真实基准（benchmark）的空白，为后续研究提供了重要的评测资源。基于实验发现，作者提出了面向未来数据清洗研究的指导性建议（guidelines），呼吁研究社区关注方法在真实数据上的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title: Test-Time Verification for Text-to-SQL via Outcome Reward Models
comment: Accepted to the SURGeLLM Workshop at ACL 2026, San Diego, US
summary: Improving the reliability of large language models (LLMs) at inference time is a central challenge in structured reasoning tasks such as Text-to-SQL. Common test-time inference strategies, including Best-of-N sampling and Majority Voting, rely on heuristic signals such as execution success or output frequency, which provide limited semantic discrimination across candidate outputs. In this work, we study Outcome Reward Models (ORMs) as learned semantic scoring functions for test-time verification in Text-to-SQL. While ORMs have been previously explored for test-time scaling and alignment, their application to structured query generation remains underexplored. We introduce GradeSQL, a scalable framework for training task-specific ORMs via automated candidate generation and execution-based labeling, enabling verifier training without manual annotation. We integrate ORMs into a verification-driven Best-of-N pipeline and evaluate our approach on the BIRD and Spider benchmarks across multiple open-source LLM families. ORM-based selection consistently outperforms execution-based Best-of-N and Majority Voting, with gains of up to +4.33% on BIRD and +2.10% on Spider. We further show that ORMs scale effectively with larger candidate sets and yield stronger improvements on complex queries. Overall, our results demonstrate that ORM-based verification provides a simple, effective, and scalable alternative to heuristic test-time selection strategies for Text-to-SQL. Code datasets and models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: GradeSQL提出了一种可扩展的框架，通过自动候选生成和基于执行的标注来训练任务特定的结果奖励模型（ORM），用于Text-to-SQL任务的测试时验证。该方法在BIRD和Spider基准测试中优于基于执行反馈的Best-of-N和多数投票策略。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在结构化推理任务（如Text-to-SQL）中的推理可靠性仍是一个核心挑战。常见的测试时推理策略（如Best-of-N采样和多数投票）依赖执行成功或输出频率等启发式信号，对候选输出的语义区分能力有限。ORM虽已在测试时扩展和对齐任务中被探索，但在结构化查询生成中的应用仍未被充分研究。
AI.method: 1. 提出GradeSQL框架：通过自动化候选生成和基于执行的标注来训练任务特定的ORM，无需人工标注；2. 将ORM集成到基于验证的Best-of-N流程中作为学习到的语义评分函数；3. 在BIRD和Spider基准上使用多个开源LLM家族进行评估，比较ORM选择与执行反馈的Best-of-N及多数投票方法。
AI.result: 在BIRD和Spider基准测试中，基于ORM的选择方法始终优于基于执行的Best-of-N和多数投票，在BIRD上提升高达+4.33%，在Spider上提升+2.10%。ORM在更大的候选集上能有效扩展，并在复杂查询上产生更强的改进效果。
AI.conclusion: 基于ORM的验证为Text-to-SQL任务中的启发式测试时选择策略提供了一种简单、有效且可扩展的替代方案。该研究表明，学习到的语义评分函数比传统的执行反馈或频率统计等启发式方法在结构化查询生成中具有更好的判别能力。

title: Large Databases Need Small, Open-Weight Language Models
summary: Language model systems built around proprietary APIs often operate on a token-based cost model. This becomes prohibitively expensive in the context of large databases, where LM-enhanced relational operators can incur costs exceeding $10,000 for a single set of experiments, hindering thorough research and practical deployment. In this paper, we demonstrate that quantized, open-weight models running locally on just 16GB of VRAM can match or exceed the accuracy of closed-source counterparts at lower latency and a fraction of the price, challenging the prevailing assumption that closed-source LM APIs are necessary for effective LM-database integration. We present and analyze the key system optimizations required to efficiently deploy these open-weight models within an LM-DB system. By integrating these local models into the BlendSQL v0.1.0 framework, we demonstrate a 390x reduction in overall costs and 3.8x reduction in latency compared to a proprietary LM API. We make our code available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文展示了在16GB显存上本地运行的量化开源权重模型可以在LM-DB系统中匹配或超越闭源API的性能，同时实现390倍成本降低和3.8倍延迟降低。
AI.motivation: 基于专有API的语言模型系统在大型数据库场景中成本过高（单次实验可超过10,000美元），阻碍了LM-DB集成的研究与部署；本文挑战了"必须使用闭源LM API才能实现有效LM-数据库集成"的普遍假设。
AI.method: 使用量化开源权重模型在仅16GB显存的本地GPU上部署；提出并分析将其集成到LM-DB系统中的关键系统优化；将这些本地模型集成到BlendSQL v0.1.0框架中，与专有LM API进行对比实验。
AI.result: 在准确率上匹配或超越闭源对应模型；整体成本降低390倍；延迟降低3.8倍；证明了在消费级硬件上高效运行LM-DB系统的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 本地运行的量化开源权重模型可以替代昂贵的闭源LM API用于数据库集成任务，为LM-DB系统的研究和实际部署提供了经济高效的替代方案。

title: What Drives Interactive Improvement from Feedback?
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, accepted to the RLxF Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: We study when natural-language feedback produces improvement beyond the gains obtainable from repeated attempts alone. In multi-turn language agent setting, higher final accuracy can reflect useful feedback, but it can also arise from resampling, format correction, or additional test-time computation. To separate these effects, we introduce a controlled student-teacher protocol across Omni-MATH, Codeforces, BBEH Linguini, and ARC-AGI1, evaluating thirteen open-weight models in both student and teacher roles. We compare external feedback, self-feedback, and unguided self-refinement, while varying interaction history, task difficulty, and teacher access to privileged task information. Across settings, we find that multi-turn improvement is often not evidence of feedback use: self-generated feedback adds little beyond unguided self-refinement, whereas the strongest external teachers produce substantially larger feedback-specific gains, suggesting that useful feedback must provide guidance beyond generic retry. Dense student-teacher interaction matrices further show that interactive gains are driven more by the student's ability to use feedback than by the teacher's identity, although teacher choice remains important for a fixed student. These results suggest that feedback-based agents should be evaluated against repeated-attempt baselines, and that ability to act on feedback, not merely feedback availability, is a central bottleneck for interactive improvement. We release our controlled student-teacher evaluation framework at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自然语言反馈何时能产生超越"重复尝试"所带来的性能提升。作者构建了一个受控的"学生-教师"评估协议，在四个可验证推理任务上对13个开源模型进行了密集的交互矩阵实验，核心结论是：多轮性能提升往往并非真正利用了反馈，而是来自额外的测试时计算；真正驱动交互式改进的是学生利用反馈的能力，而非教师的身份。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地以智能体形式部署（编码智能体、计算机使用智能体等），"从反馈中改进"成为一项关键能力。然而现有研究将多种机制纠缠在一起：模型可能因为获得有用的纠正信息而改进，也可能只是因为多了一次采样、格式修正或更多测试时计算而改进。此外，反馈系统的瓶颈可能来自教师（无法识别错误）也可能来自学生（无法将诊断转化为更好的解）。本文旨在解耦这些机制，识别反馈改进的真正驱动因素。
AI.method: 1. **受控学生-教师协议**：在可验证任务上，学生先尝试，若失败则教师提供自然语言反馈，学生继续改进，直到正确或达到最大轮数K=10。2. **四个可验证环境**：Omni-MATH（奥林匹克数学）、Codeforces（编程竞赛）、BBEH Linguini（规则学习）、ARC-AGI1（抽象推理网格）。3. **密集模型矩阵**：13个开源模型（Gemma4、Llama-3.x、Qwen3.5、GPT-OSS，1B-120B）均同时担任学生和教师角色，形成169对的完整网格。4. **三种反馈条件对比**：外部反馈（最强教师）、自反馈（同一模型既当学生又当教师）、无引导自我改进（仅重试无反馈）。5. **消融实验**：变化交互历史长度h∈{1,2,3,4,5}、交互预算K∈{1,5,10}、教师对特权信息（答案/解题过程）的访问。6. **指标**：acc@k、原始增益、归一化增益ngain、AUC。
AI.result: 核心发现（六个RF）：**RF1**：自反馈在自改进基线之上提升不一致（acc@10变化-1.2到+8.7点），而最强外部教师可额外带来9.2-16.6点提升——多轮提升不等于反馈利用。**RF2**：首轮准确率与反馈吸收是不同能力；例如GPT-OSS-120B首轮更强但Gemma4-31B从反馈中获益更大，最终结果更优。**RF3**：学生身份解释77.1%-96.5%的增益方差，教师身份仅解释1.3%-12.4%——学生能力是主要瓶颈。**RF4**：教师单轮解题能力（Spearman ρ=0.21-0.56）只是部分预测其交互式教学能力，28.9%-41.4%的对比对出现反转。**RF5**：长交互历史有帮助但取决于能力（Codeforces提升0.123 AUC，BBEH仅0.038）。**RF6**：特权信息帮助具有选择性（BBEH Linguini提升巨大但其他环境收益较小）；且教师泄漏率不超过5%。反馈增益呈"前置"模式：第2次尝试贡献30.5%-58.1%总增益，K=5时累计恢复70.8%-86.8%。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了评估反馈驱动型智能体的新标准：**（1）必须与重复尝试基线对比**，否则会将额外推理算力误判为反馈使用；**（2）教师选择不应仅基于单轮解题准确率**，因为强解题者不一定是强教师；**（3）长历史和特权教师信息应被视为针对性干预**，只在它们能解决真实诊断瓶颈时才有用，且带来成本、上下文压力和泄漏风险。核心启示：反馈可用性并非关键瓶颈，**学生利用反馈的能力**才是交互式改进的中心瓶颈。作者发布了受控学生-教师评估框架，为训练"更好的反馈使用者"提供了诊断工具。未来工作可将此诊断协议与后训练相结合，并扩展到长时域、闭源模型及计算机使用等场景。

title: Contrastive Reflection for Iterative Prompt Optimization
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. To appear at Agent4IR @ KDD 2026 (KDD 2026 Workshop on AI Agents for Information Retrieval)
summary: LLM agents are becoming central to information retrieval: they issue retrieval queries, synthesize answers, and increasingly serve as judges for IR evaluation. Improving the prompts that control these agents is an optimization problem, but in applied IR settings it often looks less like blind search and more like debugging. Engineers need to know which behavior failed, which nearby behavior still worked, what distinguishes the two, and whether a prompt edit improves held-out quality without introducing regressions. We present Contrastive Reflection, an iterative prompt-optimization framework for agentic IR workflows. The framework starts from a task-centric quality definition: QA agents expose retrieval or reasoning traces, and grading agents expose dimension-level scores and rationales. These structured traces are used to identify error-anchored behavioral slices, add nearby successful examples from the same region, and ask a Teacher LLM to propose a targeted prompt edit. Candidate edits are accepted only when validation performance improves, optionally subject to regression checks. We instantiate the framework with a tree-based slice selector, but the contribution is the contrastive reflection loop rather than the tree itself. On a public HotpotQA retrieval-augmented QA setup, one tree-selected contrastive repair improves held-out exact-match accuracy from 51.4% to 60.4%. Failure-only and random-evidence variants improve less and break more previously correct examples. A light instruction-only comparison places the method near modern prompt optimizers: MIPROv2 reaches 59.4% and GEPA 57.0%. The result is an interpretable optimization loop for IR agents, aimed at making prompt repair more inspectable and validation-driven.

AI.tldr: Contrastive Reflection 是一种面向智能体化信息检索（IR）工作流的迭代式 Prompt 优化框架。它将 Prompt 优化重新定义为"调试式"过程：先通过结构化输出定位错误聚集的行为切片（slice），再从同一区域中选取附近成功案例形成对比证据，由教师 LLM 提出针对性 Prompt 编辑，仅在验证集表现提升时接受。在公开的 HotpotQA 检索增强 QA 任务上，一次基于决策树的对比修复将测试集精确匹配率从 51.4% 提升至 60.4%，表现与 MIPROv2（59.4%）和 GEPA（57.0%）等现代 Prompt 优化器相当。
AI.motivation: 现有 Prompt 优化方法（如 OPRO、APO、MIPROv2、GEPA 等）主要依赖标量验证指标、随机批次或指令-示例组合搜索，虽然能提升 Prompt 但难以给出"哪种行为被改变了"的可解释说明。当仅基于随机样本或仅基于失败样本进行反思时，编辑方向易受批次偶然性影响而非系统性错误驱动。工程师在实践中更关注：哪些用例出错、哪些类似用例仍正确、二者如何区分、修改是否带来回归。LinkedIn 的评分（grading）工作流进一步表明，任务专属的维度分数和理由比单一最终评分更能解释"如何出错"。
AI.method: 框架核心是一个迭代循环：（1）在训练/验证集上评估当前 Prompt 并缓存结构化轨迹；（2）使用切片选择器 g 在特征空间上识别错误聚集且属性可解释的区域（论文中采用 scikit-learn 的 CART 熵决策树）；（3）在同一区域内补充附近成功案例构建对比切片 C；（4）将切片路径、错误/成功对比证据、当前 Prompt 段落交给教师 LLM 生成针对性编辑 Δϕ；（5）仅当编辑后验证指标 M_val(ϕ_c) > M_val(ϕ_t) 且满足可选回归约束 R_k(ϕ_c, ϕ_0) ≤ δ_k 时接受编辑，否则保留旧 Prompt 并记录被拒策略以避免重复。任务中心化质量定义要求程序暴露结构化输出（QA 任务的中间推理步骤、检索查询、证据摘要；评分任务的维度分数和理由），这些输出同时充当切片属性、回归跟踪维度和编辑目标。算法1给出完整伪代码，遵循 ϕ_best 局部贪心更新。
AI.result: 在 HotpotQA 单预测器检索增强 QA 设置上（2000 训练 / 500 验证 / 500 测试，使用 GPT-4.1-mini 作为学生和教师模型），单步 Prompt 修复结果：基线 Prompt 测试精确匹配率 51.4%；基于树的对比修复提升至 60.4%（Δ=+9.0，95% CI [6.0, 12.0]，p<.0001），固定 54 个、破坏 9 个测试用例；仅失败变体提升至 54.6%（固定 35/破坏 19）；随机对比变体提升至 59.0%（固定 52/破坏 14）。与 DSPy 系列的轻量级对比中，MIPROv2-light 达到 59.4%，GEPA-light 达到 57.0%，本文方法在测试准确率上略优且具更优的修复-破坏比。可解释性方面，被接受的编辑可被总结为"仅返回上下文中出现的精确最终短答案，不附加解释"，对应"长答案在上下文已含答案时出错"的叶子节点。第二次树选修复因验证回退被门控拒绝，说明验证门控起作用。LinkedIn 内部评分工作流中观察到约 +12 个百分点的提升，3-5 轮达可用修复，但因数据不可分发未作公开基准。
AI.conclusion: 论文将 Prompt 优化定位为可检查、可验证的"调试循环"而非盲搜索：失败决定优化器看哪里，附近成功决定编辑必须保留什么。决策树是最简切片选择器（路径可读性强），未来可结合聚类、嵌入检索、规则挖掘或人工切片；多阶段智能体程序、多随机种子重跑、回归约束公开实验、跨任务覆盖均列为未来工作。该方法在与现代 Prompt 优化器相当或更优的同时，提供了"哪个失败模式被修复、为何修复、是否引入回归"的可审计记录。

title: How Can AI Find My Model? A Model-Finding Experimental Study Considering Data Formats, Embeddings, and Retrieval Strategies
comment: Accepted for publication in Proceedings of the 2026 Winter Simulation Conference (WSC 2026). The final published version will appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Discovering simulation models for reuse remains a fundamental challenge in Modeling and Simulation (M&S). When many models coexist, identifying those that align with a given modeling intent remains difficult. Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly retrieval-based approaches, offer a promising pathway to operate at this semantic layer. In this paper, we present an experimental study investigating the impact of data representation, transformer-based embedding models, and retrieval strategies on the discovery of simulation models using natural language queries. We evaluated performance across multiple query types using standard information retrieval metrics, including recall@5 and nDCG@5. Results show that data representation matters, open-source embedding models can achieve high performance, and reranking methods are important, especially as query complexity increases. This work provides a baseline for AI-driven model discovery and discusses its role in advancing toward AI-driven composability and interoperability.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项实验性研究，探讨了数据表示、基于Transformer的嵌入模型和检索策略对使用自然语言查询发现仿真模型的影响，旨在为AI驱动的模型发现建立基线，并推动AI驱动的可组合性与互操作性。
AI.motivation: 在建模与仿真（M&S）领域，当大量仿真模型共存时，如何根据给定的建模意图识别与之匹配的模型仍是一个根本性挑战。现有方法在语义层面操作困难，因此需要借助AI（特别是基于检索的方法）来实现更有效的模型发现。
AI.method: 本文采用实验研究方法，评估了多个维度的影响因素：(1) 数据表示方式；(2) 基于Transformer的嵌入模型（包括开源模型）；(3) 检索策略（含重排序方法）。使用标准信息检索指标（recall@5 和 nDCG@5）在多种查询类型上进行性能评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：(1) 数据表示方式对检索性能有显著影响；(2) 开源嵌入模型能够实现高性能；(3) 重排序方法至关重要，且其重要性随着查询复杂度的增加而提升。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为AI驱动的模型发现提供了基线参考，并讨论了其在推动AI驱动的仿真模型可组合性（composability）与互操作性（interoperability）方面的重要作用和潜在发展方向。

title: BayesBench: Evaluating LLM Belief Trajectories Under Multi-Turn Evidence Accumulation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically deployed in multi-turn conversations, where each turn provides new evidence that should reduce epistemic uncertainty about their environment. Acting rationally then requires inferring the unobserved quantities that govern it and updating beliefs about them as evidence accumulates. Yet most evaluations only score the model's final-turn answer in a single-turn format, leaving this process unexamined. We ask how closely LLMs' belief updates match those of a rational Bayesian reasoner in multi-turn settings, and introduce BayesBench, a suite of simulation environments that probe this across three progressively complex tasks: (i) Bayesian estimation, where the model infers an unknown parameter from sequential evidence; (ii) Bayesian prediction, where the model turns inferred beliefs about a latent variable into outcome forecasts; and (iii) latent-framed Bayesian prediction, where observations are filtered through a user-persona framing, requiring joint inference over the latent state and the persona. Across seven LLMs (3B--70B), scaling improves latent inference and evidence accumulation, with updates occasionally matching the Bayesian posterior. However, these gains do not reliably carry over to downstream prediction, exposing a gap between inferring latent structure and using it to rationally update beliefs about the target outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BayesBench基准，用于评估大语言模型在多轮对话中是否能像理性贝叶斯推理者一样，根据累积证据逐步更新对潜在变量和目标结果的信念。研究发现，虽然模型规模扩大能改善潜在推断和证据积累，甚至偶尔匹配贝叶斯后验，但这些改进无法可靠地转化为下游预测，揭示了"潜在结构推断"与"理性信念更新以预测目标结果"之间的能力鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评测多采用单轮、仅看最终答案的形式，忽视了多轮对话中证据逐步积累、信念应当随之更新的过程。论文质疑LLM能否像理性贝叶斯推理者一样进行多轮信念更新，填补了LLM在"逐轮证据整合与信念校准"这一认知维度上的评测空白。
AI.method: 设计BayesBench仿真环境套件，包含三个递进复杂度的任务：(1) 贝叶斯估计——从序列证据中推断未知参数；(2) 贝叶斯预测——将关于潜在变量的推断转化为结果预测；(3) 潜在框架下的贝叶斯预测——观测需经用户画像过滤，需联合推断潜在状态与用户画像。在7个规模从3B到70B的LLM上系统评测其多轮信念更新轨迹与理想贝叶斯后验的匹配程度。
AI.result: 模型规模扩大显著提升了潜在推断质量和证据积累能力，部分情况下其更新轨迹可匹配贝叶斯后验分布。然而，这些潜在层面的增益并未稳定地迁移到下游预测任务：在最终结果预测上，模型仍频繁出现信念校准不足或不一致的现象，暴露了从"知道潜在结构"到"据此理性预测"的转化失败。
AI.conclusion: LLM的"潜在推断"与"基于推断的理性预测"之间存在显著的能力鸿沟；单纯扩大模型规模无法弥合这一差距。这表明当前LLM在多轮交互中的信念更新机制尚不完整，未来的研究需要专门针对"逐轮信念校准与下游推理衔接"进行改进，而不仅仅是增强潜在表征能力。

title: When Does Learning to Stop Help? A Cost-Aware Study of Early Exits in Reasoning Models
summary: Reasoning models spend different amounts of useful computation across instances, but it remains unclear when a learned stopping rule improves over simple confidence or convergence thresholds. We study this question with LearnStop, a hidden-state-free checkpoint stopper for reasoning language models. At fixed budget checkpoints, LearnStop probes a short answer from the current reasoning prefix and predicts prefix correctness from online features such as answer confidence, entropy, prefix vote share, answer stability, and backtracking-marker density. Across 18 task-model settings spanning GSM8K, MATH-500, MMLU-Pro, AIME-90, GPQA, Qwen3, and DeepSeek-R1 distillations, the answer is task-dependent. On free-form math, learned multi-feature stopping improves the fixed-budget frontier and often beats scalar exits: on GSM8K with Qwen3-32B, the empirical frontier reaches a post-hoc peak adapt gain of +0.157, validation-selected operating points preserve positive gains, and the paired gain over the strongest scalar baseline is +0.028. On multiple-choice and very hard settings, scalar confidence, entropy, or stability rules are competitive or stronger. We therefore frame learned stopping not as a universal replacement for scalar exits, but as a tool whose value depends on trajectory structure. We further provide validation-selected operating points, paired bootstrap tests, finite-grid lost-correct risk calibration, cost accounting under KV-fork, prefix-cache, and black-box regimes, H100 serving profiles, checkpoint-schedule sweeps, transfer analyses, and robustness checks. The main practical finding is that learned stopping is useful when many questions become correct before full budget but do not exhibit a single reliable scalar stopping signal; its benefits largely disappear when confidence or answer convergence already solves the stopping problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理语言模型中学习式早停策略相比简单置信度/收敛阈值的适用条件,提出 LearnStop(基于前缀可观测特征、无需隐状态的逻辑回归检查点停止器)。在18个任务-模型设置上的核心结论是:学习式停止并非万能,其价值取决于任务轨迹结构——在自由形式数学任务(GSM8K、MATH-500)上能稳定优于标量基线(峰值自适应增益最高+0.157),但在多选题(MMLU-Pro)和极难任务(AIME-90、GPQA)上,简单的置信度、熵或稳定性规则已足够甚至更强。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型通过消耗更多测试时计算(生成长推理链)来提升性能,但这引发服务部署难题:固定token预算会在简单问题上浪费计算,而激进截断又可能损害难题的自纠正过程。现有系统采用置信度、熵、答案收敛或风险约束来逐实例调整推理预算,但学习式停止器并非"免费午餐"——它需要训练数据、阈值选择、探针开销以及支持暂停和恢复生成的服务接口。因此需要回答一个核心问题:学习式停止相比强标量基线何时真正有价值?
AI.method: LearnStop的核心设计包括:(1) 在固定预算检查点网格(默认[0,128,192,256,384,512,640,768,1024,1536]tokens)处附加"停止思考"标记,贪心解码最多48 tokens的短答案作为探针;(2) 提取前缀可观测特征向量(归一化预算、检查点索引、平均答案对数概率、答案token熵、答案与上一检查点是否一致、当前答案运行长度、前缀投票份额、回溯标记密度),训练逻辑回归(分组5折交叉验证)预测前缀正确性概率p_{i,j}≥τ时停止;(3) 显式避免使用隐状态以便于跨模型家族部署;(4) 采用有限网格Hoeffding上界对"丢失正确风险"(L_i(τ)=𝟙{F_i=1,S_i(τ)=0})进行风险校准,为阈值选择提供用户可控的α参数;(5) 评估指标包括峰值自适应增益(经验前沿最优)、验证选择增益和配对bootstrap检验,以及三种成本核算制度(KV-fork、前缀缓存、纯黑盒API)。
AI.result: 关键实验结果:(1) GSM8K-Qwen3-32B上学习式停止器峰值自适应增益达+0.157[95%CI:+0.132,+0.183],配对比较最优标量基线(熵退出)仍有+0.028的显著优势[+0.002,+0.053];(2) MATH-500-8B上学习式停止器比熵退出高+0.023[+0.005,+0.042];(3) 在MMLU-Pro(多选题)和AIME-90/GPQA(难题)上,学习式停止器未能击败最强标量基线;(4) 特征消融显示增益来自多特征互补而非单一信号——GSM8K-32B上置信度单独+0.088、熵单独+0.136、稳定性单独+0.093、八特征全集+0.157;(5) 风险校准在α=0.15时GSM8K-32B测试风险0.040、准确率0.915、思考token节省54.4%、总token节省32.5%;(6) 部署成本关键:纯黑盒API场景下探针开销可能抵消甚至逆转节省,而KV-fork场景下MATH-500-32B总token节省达82.2%;(7) 迁移分析显示MATH-500→GSM8K(难到易)目标校准增益+0.179接近目标训练,但反向和跨家族(Qwen3→DeepSeek-R1蒸馏)迁移不稳定;(8) 6个线性检查点即可保留10个检查点峰值的96.3%,提示部署可优先使用稀疏网格。
AI.conclusion: 学习式早停不应被视为标量退出规则的通用替代品,而应被视为一个任务感知的部署组件。其价值出现在这样的场景:大量问题在达到全预算之前已正确解决,但缺乏单一可靠的标量停止信号(典型如自由形式数学);当置信度或答案收敛已能解决停止问题时(典型如多选题),其优势基本消失。论文将早停从"单一方法竞赛"重新定位为"设计问题"——应根据目标任务的轨迹结构与真实服务成本模型,选择能捕获该结构的最简单停止信号。实际部署需结合:验证选择的运行点、有限网格风险校准、以及基于实际部署制度(KV-fork/前缀缓存/黑盒)的成本核算,并配备全思考回退机制以应对高风险场景。

title: Beyond expert users: agents should help users construct preferences, not just elicit them
summary: Agents typically assume an expert user -- one with well-formed preferences about what they want -- and default to clarifying questions whenever the task is underspecified. We argue this assumption is unrealistic. Users often lack the domain knowledge to have completely specified preferences; if asked about their preference on some feature, the user may be unable to answer without the agent helping the user to learn some domain knowledge needed to form a preference for that feature, e.g., via examples or explanations. To formalize these principles, we draw on the Search-Experience-Credence framework from Information Economics to introduce CoPref, a model of how users construct preferences based on agent dialog actions. We then study these ideas concretely in agentic recommender systems, proposing CoShop, an interactive benchmark. In CoShop, an agent converses with and makes recommendations for a CoPref user. The agent's performance depends on whether it can help the user gain the knowledge needed to specify the task well. Evaluating five frontier models, we find that no agent exceeds 56% accuracy on CoShop despite five turns of interaction. Failures stem not from agents' ability to find items, but from how little the interaction expands what users know about what they want.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了AI代理默认"用户是专家"的假设，提出用户通常缺乏领域知识来形成完整偏好。为此，作者提出CoPref模型（基于信息经济学的Search-Experience-Credence框架）来形式化用户偏好的构建过程，并设计CoShop交互基准测试。五款前沿模型在该基准上准确率均未超过56%，失败源于代理未能有效帮助用户扩展其知识边界。
AI.motivation: 传统智能代理通常假设用户具备完善的专业知识和清晰偏好的"专家用户"模式，在任务欠明确时倾向于通过澄清问题来获取信息。然而现实中，用户往往缺乏相关领域知识，无法在未被辅助的情况下形成完整偏好。如果代理能通过示例或解释帮助用户学习必要的领域知识，用户才能形成有效的偏好判断。这一现实差距是论文的核心出发点。
AI.method: 1. 理论建模：基于信息经济学中的Search-Experience-Credence（搜索-体验-信任）框架，提出CoPref模型，形式化描述用户如何基于代理的对话行为构建偏好。2. 基准设计：提出CoShop交互式基准，专门用于评估代理式推荐系统。3. 评估方式：CoPref用户与代理进行多轮对话，代理需要在交互中帮助用户获取明确任务所需的知识，而非仅做信息检索。4. 模型测试：评估了五款前沿大语言模型在五轮交互下的表现。
AI.result: 1. 表现不佳：所有测试的前沿模型在CoShop基准上准确率均未超过56%。2. 失败原因诊断：失败并非源于代理"找不到商品"等基础能力缺陷，而是源于交互过程未能有效扩展用户对自身偏好的认知。3. 揭示问题：当前的智能代理在"通过教育性对话帮助用户构建偏好"方面能力薄弱。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了当前AI代理设计中的一个重要盲点：它们假设用户已经知道自己的需求，而忽视了大量现实场景中用户需要通过交互来学习和构建偏好的情况。CoPref模型和CoShop基准为研究这一重要但被忽视的问题提供了理论基础和评估工具，表明现有系统在"教学型对话"能力上存在显著不足，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Investigating Multi-Agent Deliberation in Law
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for presentation at the AIDA2J Workshop during the 21st International Conference of AI & Law in Singapore, June 8 2026
summary: Artificial Intelligence is increasingly applied to the field of law, and has the potential to increase access to justice. One particular movement that is gaining traction is that of agentic AI, wherein AI agents, based on Large Language Models (LLMs) can take autonomous actions. In particular, multi-agent approaches in the legal domain remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate multi-agent deliberation methods for legal reasoning tasks using LLMs. We explore multi-agent deliberation (MAD) and introduce two novel multi-agent frameworks inspired by courtroom procedures and legal argumentation. Our experiments on both legal and non-legal benchmarks reveal that multi-agent frameworks achieve comparable overall performance to baseline large language models, but produce significantly distinct answers. Notably, these approaches can successfully solve cases that the baseline fails to address, and vice versa. We conduct a qualitative evaluation and highlight scenarios where multi-agent frameworks outperform monolithic approaches. For example, multi-agent approaches appear better suited for answering questions that require critical thinking from multiple perspectives. Our work positions multi-agent systems as a promising direction for AI in the legal domain, while demonstrating the potential of law-inspired multi-agent approaches for deliberation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于LLM的多智能体审议方法在法律推理任务中的应用，提出了两种受法庭程序和法律论证启发的新框架（3-Ply和Parrots），与标准MAD框架及基线LLM在5个基准上进行比较。核心发现：多智能体框架的总体性能与基线相当（平均F1差距≤1.5分），但其决策模式显著不同，能解决基线无法处理的问题，反之亦然。多智能体方法在需要多视角批判性思考的歧义性问题上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 法律推理本质上是多视角、对抗性和审议性的过程，涉及解释、价值权衡和开放式概念的运用。然而当前基于LLM的法律审议方法通常依赖单一模型产生单一叙事，存在"隧道视野"风险，容易忽视替代解释。多智能体系统（agentic AI）在法律领域的研究仍较少被探索，作者希望探索受法律程序启发的多智能体框架是否能更好地捕捉和评估法律推理中的竞争性视角。
AI.method: 1）提出并比较4个框架：(a) Baseline——单次LLM调用；(b) MAD——3个智能体两轮审议，多数投票决定（9次调用）；(c) 3-Ply——模拟法庭，原告/被告/法官三方角色，原告主张"yes"，被告主张"no"，法官裁决（4次调用）；(d) Parrots——"Alex"智能体与4只"批判性鹦鹉"（苏格拉底、犬儒、折中、亚里士多德）对话（动态轮次，平均3.48次调用）。2）数据集：LEXAM、COLIEE、SARA、PRIVACY（4个法律任务）+ LOGIQA（逻辑推理），均为二分类yes/no。3）每个数据集采样250题，共1250题，使用BM25进行2-shot提示，使用GPT-5-mini模型。4）评估指标：F1分数、McNemar检验、错误分析、定性分析。
AI.result: 1）所有多智能体框架与基线在决策模式上差异显著（McNemar检验 p<0.001），但总体F1分数差异不显著（差距≤1.5分）。2）多智能体框架在与基线分歧的案例中，正确率分别为：MAD 51.9%、3-Ply 47.0%、Parrots 42.6%，表明能解决基线失败的问题，反之亦然。3）Privacy数据集上出现非对称现象：基线失败的许多案例被多智能体框架正确解决，反向则不然。4）MAD增加反思轮次和智能体数量对性能影响有限，但增加了与基线的正确分歧数。5）错误分析显示3-Ply的假阴性率（65.59%）显著低于其他框架（约82%），反映其极化设计的影响。6）定性分析表明多智能体框架在处理歧义性条款（如字面vs实用解释）时优于基线，并能产出更丰富的论证。7）幻觉是各框架的共同局限，多智能体方法计算成本更高但性能提升不明显。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体审议方法在法律推理中并未带来整体性能提升，但其核心价值在于产生与基线显著不同的答案集，从而提供替代视角和补充解决方案。受法庭程序和论证理论启发的3-Ply和Parrots框架展示了法律启发式多智能体方法的潜力。未来方向包括：建立多解释推理的标准化评估方法、探索神经符号方法集成形式化论证、以及实证评估基于角色和视角的智能体架构如何减轻谄媚行为（sycophancy）。研究受限于使用较小的商用模型（GPT-5-mini）、LLM的随机性以及潜在的数据污染问题。

title: Why Solve It Twice? Hierarchical Accumulation of Skills for Transfer-Efficient ML Engineering
comment: 19 pages. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Deep Learning for Code (DL4C)
summary: ML engineering agents waste compute rediscovering known techniques because every competition is a cold start. We present HASTE, a hierarchical multi-agent system that organizes cross-competition knowledge into three scope tiers (global, domain, and competition-specific), each coupled to a matching agent level. An orchestrator coordinates domain specialists and promotes learning between tiers via LLM-driven abstraction. A controlled ablation provides evidence for scoped loading: holding a 159-skill inventory constant across 8 competitions, tiered loading achieves a 100% medal rate while flat loading reaches only 62.5%, the same medal rate as loading no skills, and consumes 2x the output tokens. On the full MLE-Bench Lite benchmark (22 Kaggle competitions), HASTE reaches a medal rate of 77.3% using Claude Sonnet 4.6 at 12h per competition. In a cold-start run, the system begins with no accumulated skills. In warm-start runs, it reloads skills learned from earlier competitions, using only global and domain-level skills for transfer across competitions. Warm starts use 52% fewer refinement iterations, and the fraction of proposed changes kept by the agent rises from 42% at low inventory to 85% once 50+ skills are available. These results suggest that better knowledge organization can partly substitute for model strength and compute budget in ML-engineering agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HASTE 系统，将跨竞赛积累的技能按适用域分为 global / domain / competition 三级，与 orchestrator + 领域 specialist 的多智能体结构耦合，通过 LLM 驱动抽象完成层间晋升。在 MLE-Bench Lite（22 项 Kaggle 竞赛）上以 Claude Sonnet 4.6 + 12h 预算取得 77.3% 奖牌率，与使用前沿模型 + 24h 预算的头部系统同档。固定 159 条技能清单的消融实验表明，分级加载取得 100% 奖牌率，而扁平加载与空加载均仅 62.5%，且扁平加载消耗 2 倍输出 token，证实"作用域匹配"是关键增益机制。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLE 智能体将每场比赛视为冷启动，反复重发现已知技术；既有跨任务知识库多采用扁平存储（如 Voyager、ExpeL、MLCopilot），将无关技能塞入同一上下文，信号被稀释。作者认为：决定跨任务迁移效率的不是技能数量，而是技能的组织方式（按适用域分层），并提出"更好的知识组织可在一定程度上替代模型能力与算力预算"。
AI.method: 1) 三级技能库（纯文本 markdown+YAML frontmatter，按文件系统目录组织）：Global（5 条，所有 specialist 加载）、Domain（NLP 12 / 表格 19 / 视觉 15，按 specialist 匹配加载）、Competition（108 条跨 21 个目录，仅本场重跑时加载）；条目又分为 Technique、Commitment priors、Refinement hints 三类，写入不同 prompt 槽位。2) 智能体层级：Orchestrator 负责领域分类、轮次调度与技能晋升（LLM 决策 skip/competition/domain/global/conflict，并支持带条件注解的冲突共存）；领域 Specialist 执行五阶段流水线——Task Profiling → Prototype Screen（多样性筛选 3 个异构模型）→ Adaptive Refinement（线性循环，三档探索/优化/微调，两次不增即自动升级，回归即回退，胜出者 N=20、亚军 N=6 作为对冲）→ Rank-Average 集成 → Produce Learnings（6 模式失败诊断分类法辅助反思）。3) 简单文件读取式加载，避免嵌入检索；承诺先验与微调提示由 Prior Extractor 从日志算法提取，其余依赖 LLM 反思。
AI.result: 主结果（MLE-Bench Lite，22 项）：77.3% 奖牌率（10 金 2 银 5 铜，上分率 86.4%），与 Gemini-3-Pro / Claude Opus 4.6 类头部系统同档，但仅用非前沿模型 + 12h 预算。冷启动单跑仅 40.9%，加载 global+domain 技能后提升 36.4 个百分点；13 个冷启动失败场次中 8 个翻盘夺牌。效率：warm start 精炼迭代均值 7.8（冷启 16.3，减少 52%）；技能命中率从 0–15 条时的 42% 升至 50+ 条时的 85%。固定 159 条技能的消融（8 场）：Tiered 100%（6 金 1 银 1 铜），Flat 62.5%，Empty 62.5%；tokens/奖牌 Tiered 284K vs Flat 756K vs Empty 372K，扁平加载虽多跑了 25% 实验但奖牌率与空加载持平。最终技能库 159 条（5 global / 15 vision / 12 NLP / 19 tabular / 108 competition），如"强弱模型集成可能拖累性能"（学自 dogs-vs-cats，后阻止另两场视觉比赛重蹈覆辙）。
AI.conclusion: 知识组织可部分替代模型能力与算力预算：HASTE 证明非前沿模型在 12h 预算下即可进入 MLE-Bench Lite 头部性能带，固定清单消融将增益归因于作用域匹配的加载机制而非技能体量。局限：单种子评测，统计功效不足（Wilcoxon p≈0.08–0.11，Fisher p=0.10），多种子复现、75 场完整评测、检索增强加载与组件级消融（如原型筛选、亚军分支、集成）均为后续工作。

title: RoPoLL: Robust Panel of LLM Judges
summary: The LLM Jury, a Panel of LLM Evaluators (PoLL) reporting consensus scores, has become a practical alternative to single-judge LLM evaluation, yet its statistical behavior remains poorly understood. We formalize the LLM Jury under the Huber contamination model and show that PoLL incurs unbounded bias under any positive contamination, regardless of jury size, whenever a single judge fails in a biased, LLM-typical way (mode collapse, sycophancy, safety refusal). Framing jury consensus as classical robust mean estimation, we propose RoPoLL (Robust Panel of LLM-as-Judge), which preserves the PoLL panel but replaces the aggregation function with a robust mean estimator, instantiated with the geometric median (GM): tuning-free, with the optimal finite-sample breakdown point 1/2. A finite-sample error bound and a matching information-theoretic minimax lower bound agree on the parametric rate sigma*sqrt(d/N) and differ on the breakdown floor by a factor of sqrt(d), a statistical-computational gap that polynomial-time RoPoLL pays relative to the intractable Tukey halfspace median. Across 13 open-weight judges (4B-675B), three reward-model benchmarks, and four corruption regimes at rates up to 50%, RoPoLL dominates PoLL on every biased corruption type: by about 19% on cross-dimensional attacks at matched compute, and by orders of magnitude on heavy-tailed Byzantine adversaries. A 3-judge RoPoLL committee at 38B beats Mistral-Large-3 (675B) by 1.31x on HelpSteer-2 under 30% bimodal-random corruption, an 18x parameter advantage at better accuracy; a Noisy-GT control confirms the premium is paid against biased contamination, not benign imprecision.

AI.tldr: RoPoLL提出用几何中位数替换PoLL（Panel of LLM Evaluators）的算术平均聚合函数，以应对LLM评判中的偏置污染问题。该方法在重尾和跨维度攻击下显著优于PoLL。
AI.motivation: LLM评判委员会（PoLL）使用算术平均聚合分数，但其统计行为在面对偏置污染（如模式崩溃、谄媚、安全拒绝等LLM典型失败模式）时未被充分理解。研究旨在揭示PoLL在污染下的脆弱性并提出鲁棒替代方案。
AI.method: 将LLM评判聚合重新定义为Huber污染模型下的鲁棒均值估计问题，用几何中位数（GM）替代算术平均。理论分析包括有限样本误差上界（Theorem 1）和匹配的极小极大下界（Theorem 2）。算法采用修改的Weiszfeld迭代，复杂度为O(Nd log(1/ε))。实验使用13个开放权重评判模型（4B-675B）、三个奖励模型基准（HelpSteer 2/3、UltraFeedback）和四种污染类型（zeros、inverted、bimodal-random、cauchy-far）。
AI.result: RoPoLL在所有偏置污染类型上均优于PoLL：跨维度攻击下匹配计算量时提升约19%，重尾拜占庭对手下提升数个数量级。3个38B参数的RoPoLL委员会在30% bimodal-random污染下击败675B的Mistral-Large-3达1.31倍（18倍参数优势）。干净基线下的保险费不超过6.4%相对RMSE。Noisy-GT控制实验确认RoPoLL的收益针对偏置污染而非良性噪声。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒聚合（而非集成本身）是小而多样化委员会能够参数高效替代单个大型LLM评判的关键。RoPoLL应作为LLM评判委员会聚合的默认方法，为污染类诊断可推广到任何异构工作者产生偏置点质量错误的流水线。

title: AgRefactor: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflow for HLS Compatibility and Performance
summary: High-Level Synthesis (HLS) provides a fast path from concepts to silicon, but converting real-world software into synthesizable HLS code remains challenging due to restrictive language support and the gap between software and hardware programming practices. Existing automated and LLM-based refactoring approaches partially address this problem, yet they often lack flexibility, struggle to scale, and incur high computational costs. We introduce AgRefactor, an LLM-based multi-agent workflow for refactoring software into HLS-compatible programs. AgRefactor incorporates a self-evolving memory system that accumulates and retrieves factual and strategic knowledge across tasks, improving robustness and efficiency on unseen programs. To reduce cost and enhance scalability, it integrates automated refactoring tools, enabling agents to balance LLM-driven rewrites with efficient tool-based transformations. On 9 out of 11 challenging real-world benchmarks, which are 5-10x longer than the most complex cases studied in prior work, AgRefactor outperforms or matches the state-of-the-art automated refactoring tool and a strong LLM-based baseline built on the same framework backbone. Further agentic performance optimization yields a 6.51x geometric mean speedup over the SoTA pragma tuning tool and a 1.20x speedup over optimized open-source designs with less than 20% extra resources. AgRefactor is fully-automated and open-sourced.

AI.tldr: AgRefactor 是一个基于 LLM 的多智能体工作流，用于将真实世界软件代码重构为 HLS（高层次综合）兼容程序。它通过自演化记忆系统积累事实性与策略性知识，并集成自动化重构工具（HeteroRefactor）以降低成本与提升可扩展性，在 11 个真实基准（5-10× 长于以往工作）中的 9 个上匹配或超越现有最优方法，并实现 6.51× 的几何均值加速。
AI.motivation: 现有 HLS 重构方法面临三大核心挑战：（1）通用性差——基于规则的工具（如 HeteroRefactor）无法处理外部库（STL 容器）、复杂指针操作和嵌套结构体等真实场景；（2）可扩展性不足——现有 LLM 工作流对长程序（>1000 行）泛化能力差，且因内部 RAG 不开源而难以复现；（3）计算成本高——纯 LLM 驱动重构在迭代纠错中消耗大量 token。因此亟需一种兼具灵活性、可扩展性与低成本的重构方案。
AI.method: AgRefactor 采用 AG2 框架实现多智能体流水线，包含四个阶段：（1）测试生成——自动构造调用顶层函数的测试激励与接口假设；（2）识别与规划——6 个类别特定的 Identifier 并行运行，Item Organizer 整合去重，Planner 生成重构计划，并由长期记忆增强；（3）重构——Refactor Worker 执行计划，由 Analyzer-Fixer 迭代修复至综合/仿真通过；（4）性能优化——独立优化智能体在 CLI 环境中通过三阶段层次（结构改写→调度报告关键路径分析→pragma 精调）提升性能，配备树状工作记忆与监控器防止上下文退化。核心创新包括：（a）自演化记忆系统——以元组 (程序 p, 不可综合项 I, 策略 s, 批评 c) 存储经验，采用结合代码嵌入与不可综合项嵌入的专用距离度量 d = α|eᶜ - eᵖᶜ|₂ + (1-α)|eⁱ - eᵖⁱ|₂（α=0.6）进行检索；（b）工具集成——优先调用 HeteroRefactor，仅在其失败时由 Tool Specialist 做轻量改写以适配工具能力；（c）优化智能体——使用 Vitis HLS + LightningSim 快速迭代，并通过 EDA 日志定位关键路径瓶颈。
AI.result: 在 11 个真实世界基准（45 个核）的评估中：AgRefactor 在 9 个上匹配或超越 HeteroRefactor 和 HLSRewriter 风格基线；消融实验显示记忆机制使 GPT-5-mini 成功率在 10/11 基准上提升（82% 胜率），3 轮 epoch 累积使总通过数从 129 增至 145（+12.4%）；Tool Specialist 使总通过数从 129 增至 146（+13.2%）；性能优化阶段在 2 小时预算下取得 6.51× 几何均值加速（skyline 295.44×，word_break 28.71×，idct_generic 9.95×）；在 51 个开源 HLS 设计上以 ≤20% 额外资源实现 1.20× 加速，0%/50%/100% 资源预算下分别达到 1.14×/1.23×/1.41×；工具增强流程平均运行 4 分钟（vs 无工具 10 分钟），比人工重构快 10×，仅比 HLSRewriter 慢 9%。附录还揭示单次生成的测试激励存在约 60% 的"虚高通过"问题，作者通过 rater-loop 闭环将最低覆盖核的测试覆盖度提升至 87.3%-100%。
AI.conclusion: AgRefactor 提出了首个将自演化跨任务记忆与基于规则的重构工具相结合的多智能体 HLS 重构工作流，在通用性、可扩展性与成本三方面同时取得显著改进，超越了纯算法工具与已有 LLM 方法；其结构化重构对硬件性能的影响远大于纯 pragma 调优（AutoDSE 8 小时运行与 2 小时相同）；单次测试激励的可靠性问题被识别为重要未来方向；该项目已开源（github.com/Williamzou0123/AgRefactor）。

title: Neuro-Bayesian-Symbolic Residual Attention Shallow Network: Explainable Deep Learning for Cybersecurity Risk Assessment
comment: 19 pages, Submitted to IJCCC (Online ISSN 1841-9844, ISSN-L 1841-9836), June 25, 2026
summary: We introduce the Neuro-Bayesian-Symbolic Residual Attention Shallow Network (NBS-RASN), a hybrid neural architecture for explainable cybersecurity risk assessment in open-source ecosystems. Unlike deep models that trade interpretability for accuracy, our shallow network encodes domain knowledge, causal reasoning, and expert judgment as differentiable components. It uses 80 interpretable neurons across 12 layers, including a gatekeeper that enforces five epistemological axioms - precision, causality, falsifiability, transparency, and completeness - as hard constraints before propagation. Despite limited depth, the network exhibits deep-learning traits via residual attention and feedback loops, learning complex risk patterns without becoming a black box. It produces fully decomposable scores: a deterministic weighted component plus an expert adjustment, with each adjustment traceable to named amplifiers (blast radius, propagation speed, structural nature, default exposure, exploitation pattern, institutional criticality). We validate on 20 open-source projects covering all OWASP Top 10:2025 categories and language risk classes, achieving confidence scores of 0.79-0.97, and show that explainability is guaranteed by design, not by a training algorithm. This challenges the assumption that deep learning requires deep networks, proving that shallow networks with deep reasoning can outperform opaque models in high-stakes cybersecurity, where interpretability is essential.

AI.tldr: 提出NBS-RASN，一种用于开源生态系统可解释网络安全风险评估的混合神经架构，仅用80个神经元和12层的浅层网络，通过将领域知识、因果推理和专家判断编码为可微分组件，结合残差注意力和反馈循环，实现深度学习特性同时保持完全可解释性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在网络安全风险评估中以可解释性换取准确性，形成黑箱问题；而在高风险网络安全场景中，可解释性至关重要。因此需要在不牺牲准确性的前提下保证模型的透明性与因果可追溯性。
AI.method: 1. 浅层架构设计：80个可解释神经元、12层结构，包含门控层强制执行五项认识论公理（精确性、因果性、可证伪性、透明度、完整性）作为硬约束；2. 神经-贝叶斯-符号融合：将领域知识、因果推理和专家判断编码为可微分组件；3. 残差注意力与反馈循环：在浅层结构中实现深度学习特性；4. 完全可分解评分：确定性加权组件 + 专家调整项，每项调整可追溯至命名的放大因子（爆炸半径、传播速度、结构性质、默认暴露、利用模式、机构关键性）。
AI.result: 在覆盖所有OWASP Top 10:2025类别和语言风险类别的20个开源项目上验证，置信度得分达到0.79-0.97；可解释性由设计而非训练算法保证。
AI.conclusion: 挑战了"深度学习需要深度网络"的假设，证明具有深度推理能力的浅层网络在高风险网络安全场景中可以胜过不透明模型，为可解释AI在关键安全领域的应用提供了新范式。

title: HyPOLE: Hyperproperty-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observation
summary: Formal specification is a powerful tool to guide the learning process and provides significant advantages over reward shaping: (1) mathematical rigor; (2) expressiveness to specify objectives and constraints, and (3) the ability to define tactics to achieve objectives. However, these benefits remain largely unexplored in the context of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). This paper introduces HyPOLE, a novel framework for MARL under partial observability, where learning is guided by the expressive power of the so-called hyperproperties and, in particular, the temporal logic HyperLTL. We integrate Centralized Training for Decentralized Execution (CTDE) techniques with HyPOLE to synthesize decentralized policies, and our evaluation on SMAC, MessySMAC, and WildFire benchmark demonstrates clear advantages over baselines.

AI.tldr: HyPOLE 是首个将超属性（hyperproperties）和时序逻辑 HyperLTL 引入多智能体强化学习（MARL）的框架，通过形式化规范引导部分可观测环境下的分散式策略学习，优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，传统奖励塑形方法缺乏数学严谨性，难以表达复杂的目标和约束条件。形式化规范（formal specification）虽具有数学严谨性、表达能力和策略可定义性等优势，但在部分可观测的 MARL 场景中尚未得到充分利用。
AI.method: 提出 HyPOLE 框架，将超属性（hyperproperties）与时序逻辑 HyperLTL 结合，用于在部分可观测条件下指导 MARL 的学习过程。框架集成了集中训练-分散执行（CTDE）技术，以合成去中心化的执行策略，使每个智能体在仅基于局部观测的情况下也能满足全局形式化规范。
AI.result: 在 SMAC、MessySMAC 和 WildFire 三个标准基准测试上的评估表明，HyPOLE 相较于现有基线方法具有显著优势，验证了超属性驱动的形式化规范在 MARL 中的有效性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功地将超属性形式化规范引入 MARL 领域，证明了 HyperLTL 相比传统奖励塑形方法在表达力和严谨性上的优势，为 MARL 中的安全约束、多智能体协调等复杂任务的规范学习开辟了新方向。

title: AgentBound: Verifiable Behavioral Governance for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: Autonomous AI agents increasingly perform consequential actions on behalf of human principals, including financial transactions, external communications, and enterprise workflows. Existing agent infrastructure relies on identity federation and delegated authorization to authenticate workloads and control resource access, but it cannot determine whether an authorized action should be executed under the current behavioral and operational context. We present AgentBound, a runtime governance framework that provides verifiable behavioral oversight for autonomous AI agents. AgentBound evaluates each proposed action using three independent authorities: delegated authorization, owner-signed behavioral constitutions, and site action contracts. Their judgments are conservatively composed through a formal decision model to determine whether an action should be permitted, reviewed, or denied before execution. To provide accountability, AgentBound generates cryptographically verifiable governance receipts that bind every action to the exact delegation, policy, and semantic artifacts governing the decision, enabling independent replay verification and policy provenance. The framework also introduces standing delegation for long-running agents, allowing periodic workloads to operate under continuously refreshed governance policies while preserving revocability and bounded authority. We present the formal foundation, system architecture, governance receipt protocol, and AgentBound-Bench, a benchmark framework for evaluating governance correctness, authority composition, and accountability. Rather than replacing model alignment, AgentBound complements it by providing a deterministic governance layer between authorization and execution, transforming governance from a process that must be trusted into one that can be independently verified.

AI.tldr: AgentBound 是一个针对自主 AI 代理的运行时行为治理框架,通过三权分立的决策模型(委托授权、所有者签名的行为宪法、站点动作契约)对代理的每个动作进行强制审查,并生成加密可验证的治理凭证(governance receipt),以实现独立重放审计,弥补身份认证与访问控制之间在行为层面上的治理空白。
AI.motivation: 现有的自主 AI 代理基础设施仅解决了"代理是谁"(身份联邦)和"代理能访问什么资源"(委托授权)两个问题,但无法判断在当前行为与运行环境下某个已授权的动作是否应该被执行。行为治理失败(如在缺乏审批时执行金融交易、泄露敏感信息、选择不可逆操作)既非身份缺陷也非授权缺陷,而是一个独立的结构性盲区,无法通过训练时的模型对齐解决,需要在授权与执行之间引入确定性的运行时治理层。
AI.method: 框架包含五个核心组件:代理运行时、委托服务、宪法服务(版本化且加密签名的行为策略仓库)、治理评估引擎(作为可信计算基 TCB)以及审计服务。其核心机制包括:(1) 规范动作 (canonical action) 抽象,将所有运行时事件统一为 (operation, resource, parameters, risk, context) 元组;(2) 三权并行评估,各权威产出 (verdict, constraints, obligations, provenance) 类型化判断;(3) 保守决策代数 (Deny < Review < Permit 格上单调合成),最严格判决主导,约束按合取聚合,义务累积;(4) 治理凭证四阶段生成管道,经代理与服务方有序双签,支持外部独立重放验证;(5) 站立式委托 (standing delegation) 两级模型,长期根授权为每个执行周期物化短时任务凭证,并自动刷新宪法版本;(6) AgentBound-Bench 基准测试,按四元组 (动作、委托、宪法、站点契约) 定义场景,通过治理准确率、违规逃逸率、凭证验证成功率、治理延迟四个指标及四阶段消融实验评估。
AI.result: 论文目前以形式化定义、系统架构、协议规范和基准框架设计为主,尚未报告完整的实证结果(作者明确指出全面经验结果将在未来发布)。从设计层面验证了框架在以下方面具备可行性:三权合成的四个系统属性(授权保持、行为独立、义务分离、重放可验证性),凭证验证的五个安全不变量(完整性、不可否认性、策略来源、重放可验证性、决策透明性),以及站立式委托的四个治理收益(可撤销性、策略新鲜度、有限暴露、治理连续性)。AgentBound-Bench 提供了可复现的评估规约,涵盖授权、行为治理、动作语义、合成、凭证五类场景。
AI.conclusion: AgentBound 将治理从"必须被信任的过程"转变为"可被独立验证的过程",其核心架构不变量是"范围允许了它,宪法阻止了它,凭证证明了它"。该框架作为授权与执行之间的确定性问责与执行层,补充而非取代模型对齐机制,为长期运行的周期性代理提供了结构化、可问责且加密可验证的行为治理蓝图。未来工作方向包括自动宪法生成、适应性治理、多方治理以及异构多代理生态中的互操作凭证标准。

title: When Regulation Has Memory: Hysteresis and Control Burden in Artificial Agency
summary: Adaptive agents are usually judged by what they do, but an agent can appear stable while the internal effort required to keep it stable is increasing. This hidden regulatory burden matters for artificial agents operating under noise, delay, or changing demands: two systems may reach similar internal states while one requires much more corrective control to get there. Here, we study whether that burden depends on history. Using a computational model of adaptive uncertainty regulation, we drive an artificial agent through a continuous change in its uncertainty target and then reverse the change without resetting the agent. This creates a simple test for carryover: does the controller respond only to the current target, or does the path by which the agent reached that target still matter? The simulations show a clear history-dependent effect. The adaptive gain required to regulate the agent forms a reproducible hysteresis loop, meaning that the same target can require different levels of control depending on whether the agent is moving toward or returning from a more demanding regime. The timing of regulation also matters. When stabilization is available before disturbance exposure, the agent generally requires less adaptive gain than when it can only recover after disturbance has already acted. The state-level coherence measure also shows path dependence, but the timing effect is much clearer in regulatory gain. The main difference is therefore not that anticipatory regulation produces a completely different state. Rather, it reaches comparable regulated behavior with lower modeled control demand. These results suggest that adaptive agents should be evaluated not only by whether they remain organized, but by how much regulation they must recruit to do so.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出自适应智能体不应仅以其稳定状态来评估,还应评估其维持稳定所需的调控代价。通过IRAM-Ω-Q框架,研究者在连续目标熵斜坡协议下发现自适应增益存在显著滞回效应,且"先调节后扰动"(RF)序贯相比"先扰动后调节"(DF)序贯在多数参数条件下能以更低的控制增益完成相同的历史依赖性路径。
AI.motivation: 自适应系统常以外部行为是否稳定作为评估标准,但隐藏的调控代价同样重要。两个系统可能达到相似的内部状态,而其中一个需要更多的校正控制。该研究旨在探究这种调控负担是否依赖于系统的历史轨迹,并检验因果序贯效应是否在保留历史动态的协议下仍然成立。
AI.method: 使用IRAM-Ω-Q计算框架,模拟d=16维量子态振幅向量ψ(t),通过von Neumann熵S_vN与对角熵S_diag构建相干性差距ΔC作为状态层指标,自适应增益μ(t)作为调控需求指标。采用三角形目标熵斜坡协议(0.15→0.45→0.15,30000步)与匹配种子设计(30对RF/DF轨迹),比较"先调节"与"先扰动"两种因果序贯;通过分支曲线、签名滞回面积和配对差异D_y^(b)量化历史依赖性,并在η∈{0.08,0.13,0.18}与μ₀∈{0.04,0.08,0.12}的3×3参数网格(270对共540条轨迹)上验证稳健性。
AI.result: (1)自适应增益在连续目标调制下呈现稳健滞回:升支与降支在多数目标范围内明显分离,表明同一目标值所需的控制强度取决于系统是趋向还是回退自更严苛区域;(2)DF序贯在两支上均需更高的μ,配对差异D_μ在大部分范围内为正;(3)ΔC也显示分支依赖性,但RF/DF在状态层指标上重叠,序贯分离不明显;(4)参数网格扫描显示B_μ>0在全部9个条件中均成立,8/9条件下至少93.3%的配对满足B_μ>0;B_ΔC在8/9条件下为负,但在(μ₀,η)=(0.04,0.18)角落出现符号反转。
AI.conclusion: 在保留历史的目标斜坡协议下,模拟智能体的调控动态呈现稳健的历史依赖性,自适应增益形成可复现的滞回环。核心序贯结果明确:DF控制比RF控制需要更高的自适应增益。所有9个参数组合中配对调控负担统计量B_μ均为正。相干性差距也表现出分支依赖历史,但其序贯位移不统一,在低初始增益/高扰动角落出现符号反转。因此,RF时序的主要优势在于降低调控成本而非改变可达状态——因果时序改变了调控的负担,在扰动暴露前进行稳定化可使智能体以更低的自适应努力维持组织化行为。

title: A Three-Phase Foundation Model for Tax-Aware Personalized Portfolio Management
summary: We present a three-phase deep reinforcement learning system for personalized portfolio management that addresses three limitations shared by all prior financial RL work: 1) ticker lock-in, 2) monolithic objectives , and 3) static user models. Phase 1 pretrains a ticker-identity-free cross asset encoder via self-supervised learning on a multi-asset corpus, augmented by a frozen parallel branch using Chronos, a T5-based time series foundation model, fused via a learned gating mechanism. To our knowledge, this is the first application of a time series foundation model to portfolio management RL. The encoder generalizes to any publicly traded asset via a 50-dimensional observable metadata vector that requires no retraining for new tickers. Phase 2 fine-tunes a MoE (Mixture of Experts) portfolio actor critic with PPO under an objective-conditioned reward that simultaneously serves six distinct investment goals sampled per episode: short-term alpha, short-term gain, long-term gain, capital preservation, tax-loss harvesting, and long-term-gains-only. A MoE architecture assigns each objective to a specialized expert head (momentum, growth, defensive, tax-aware), and a learned intent router blends experts based on the active objective and current market regime, which eliminates cross-objective gradient conflict. Phase 3 adds a lightweight personalization layer further adapted at inference time to each individual via a 76-parameter LoRA module fine-tuned on real brokerage transaction history, inferring investment objectives from revealed trading behavior rather than questionnaires. A natural language intent parser converts free-form goals directly into structured investment objective parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于个性化投资组合管理的三阶段深度强化学习系统，针对现有金融RL方法存在的三大局限：股票代码锁定（ticker lock-in）、单一目标函数（monolithic objectives）、静态用户模型（static user models）。系统结合了自监督跨资产编码器、Chronos时间序列基础模型分支、面向多目标的MoE（Mixture of Experts）PPO策略以及基于76参数LoRA的实时个性化层，并通过FastAPI部署支持实时券商集成。
AI.motivation: 现有投资管理工具存在两类极端：面向机构的量化系统需要专业背景和高额数据成本，而面向零售的智能投顾仅使用确定性规则引擎，缺乏真正的市场信号学习能力；同时，所有现有金融RL系统都受限于固定股票代码嵌入空间、单一Sharpe奖励目标以及静态问卷式用户画像，无法满足个体投资者在税务感知、目标多样性和动态偏好方面的需求。
AI.method: 三阶段架构：(1) **Phase 1 SSL预训练**——使用多资产语料库训练ticker-identity-free的跨资产编码器，结合Next-bar Return Prediction、Masked Feature Recovery、Market Regime Classification三种SSL目标，并行冻结Chronos-T5-Small（46M参数，100B+时序数据预训练）作为通用时序模式分支，通过可学习门控融合；引入inter-ticker对比损失防止表征坍缩（余弦相似度从0.96降至0.24）；使用50维可观测元数据向量（行业、基本面、分析师共识、期权信号、盈利日历、内幕交易、机构持仓等）替代固定股票代码嵌入。(2) **Phase 2 目标条件MoE强化学习**——采用PPO微调MoE actor-critic，四个专家头分别对应momentum、growth、defensive、tax-aware投资目标，可学习intent router基于当前目标和市场regime混合专家；奖励函数为objective-conditioned，同时支持6种投资目标（短期alpha、短期收益、长期收益、资本保值、税收损失收割、仅长期收益）；引入可学习cash token解决隐式现金持有问题，allocation-driven execution通过阈值δ_reb解耦权重目标与per-ticker动作；六阶段课程学习（依次训练各专家→router-only→joint+supervised→expert grafting）解决梯度冲突。(3) **Phase 3 个性化层**——通过76参数LoRA模块（rank=4）适配intent router，基于券商交易历史推断16维revealed preference向量，NL意图解析器将自由文本目标映射为结构化投资目标参数。
AI.result: **Phase 1**：对比损失将inter-ticker余弦相似度从0.96降至0.24，warm-start SSL预训练+对比损失的val loss最低（0.163）；**Phase 2**：14天walk-forward回测（2026年6月，10只成长股，EW基准-8.01%，SPY -2.76%），MoE策略实现+2.92% alpha vs EW（vs单头策略+2.70% vs坍缩表征-0.74%）；Stage 5联合训练+监督路由损失实现干净的对角路由（std>0.37），不同意图路由至不同专家（JPM、TSLA、GOOGL、AMZN）；Stage 6专家嫁接恢复+3.03% 14d EW alpha并实现最佳90d结果-2.11%；Phase 3通过四位典型投资者画像展示了正确的税后决策抑制（如接近长期持有阈值时抑制卖出、识别税损收割机会）；发现了6类关键失效模式并提出对应解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了首个将时间序列基础模型（Chronos）应用于投资组合管理RL的系统，并通过ticker-identity-free元数据编码、目标条件MoE路由、redeployment感知的换手惩罚、76参数LoRA个性化层等架构创新实现了单一策略同时服务多种投资目标的能力。系统以FastAPI生产级部署，支持实时券商集成和NL目标输入。主要局限在于当前仅在10只股票、300 episodes、单一回测窗口上验证，Phase 3个性化层尚未完成实证评估，长期窗口alpha仍为负值，股票代码池需要扩展至S&P 500以验证泛化能力。

title: Beyond Compilation: Evaluating Faithful Natural-Language-to-Lean Statement Formalization
summary: Theorem-proving benchmarks evaluate proof search against fixed formal statements, but natural-language-to-Lean formalization must generate the formal statement itself. In this setting, compilation is only a validity check: a Lean declaration may type-check while omitting hypotheses, changing domains, or expressing a vacuous claim. We study faithful statement formalization as both an evaluation problem and a bottleneck-attribution problem. On a 400-entry graduate-level benchmark spanning real analysis, complex analysis, topology, and algebra, our protocol combines Lean compilation, cross-model semantic judging, and human expert calibration. The resulting picture is different from compile-rate evaluation: a full tool-augmented agent reaches 89.5% compilation but only 60.5% consensus faithfulness, exposing a 29.0-point compile-pass but consensus-unfaithful gap. Targeted human audits support the metric as a conservative decision boundary: across available case-level audits, 96.0% of consensus-positive outputs are human-confirmed faithful, while 82.4% of compile-pass consensus-negative outputs are human-confirmed semantic failures. Under this metric, existing one-shot formalizer models and prover-oriented Lean models remain low, suggesting that formal validity, proof-oriented Lean competence, and faithful statement generation should be reported separately. We then use a full $2^3$ factorial design to decompose three recurring interventions in formalization pipelines: parametric expert drafting, Mathlib/context search, and Lean elaboration feedback. Elaboration feedback is the largest validity intervention, but it also exposes a larger compile-pass semantic-failure bucket; search mainly improves grounding and selectivity; and fine-tuned drafting is largely substitutable in this tool stack once feedback and grounding are available.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自然语言到 Lean 形式化中"忠实性"问题：Lean 代码可编译通过但语义不忠实（遗漏假设、改变论域、表达空命题）。基于 400 题研究生级基准，提出结合编译验证、跨模型语义评判和人类专家校准的评估协议，揭示工具增强智能体在 89.5% 编译率下仅 60.5% 语义忠实，存在 29.0 个百分点的"编译通过但语义失败"差距；并通过 2^3 析因设计分解了参数化专家草稿、Mathlib 检索和 Lean 细化反馈三种干预措施的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有定理证明基准仅针对固定形式化命题进行证明搜索，而自然语言到 Lean 的形式化任务还需生成命题本身。Lean 编译通过仅是语法/类型合法性检查，无法保证语义忠实性（如遗漏假设、改变论域、退化为空命题），导致编译率这一指标严重高估了形式化系统的真实能力，亟需区分"形式合法性"与"语义忠实性"两个维度。
AI.method:
1. 构建 400 题研究生级基准，涵盖实分析、复分析、拓扑与代数。
2. 提出三阶段评估协议：Lean 编译验证 → 跨模型语义评判（consensus judging）→ 人类专家校准。
3. 在该指标下，对一次性形式化器模型与面向证明的 Lean 模型进行基准测试。
4. 采用 2^3 全因子实验设计，分解三种常见干预：参数化专家草稿、Mathlib/上下文搜索、Lean 细化反馈，并分析各因子对编译率与语义忠实性的差异化影响。
AI.result:
1. 完整工具增强智能体达到 89.5% 编译率，但仅 60.5% 共识忠实性，存在 29.0 个百分点的"编译通过但共识不忠实"差距。
2. 人类审计验证指标可靠性：96.0% 共识阳性输出被人工确认为忠实，82.4% 编译通过但共识阴性的输出被人工确认为语义失败。
3. 现有一次性形式化器与面向证明的 Lean 模型在忠实性指标下均表现偏低。
4. 析因分析：Lean 细化反馈对形式合法性贡献最大，但也暴露更多"编译通过但语义失败"案例；搜索主要提升语义接地（grounding）与选择性；参数化专家草稿在反馈与接地已就位时基本可被替代。
AI.conclusion: 形式化系统应分别报告三类能力：形式合法性、面向证明的 Lean 能力与语义忠实的命题生成能力。编译率作为唯一指标会严重误导对形式化进展的判断；语义忠实性是当前更紧的瓶颈，需要专门优化（特别是细化反馈阶段的语义失败处理与接地环节），而非仅靠参数化草稿改进。

title: LabGuard: Grounding Natural-Language Laboratory Rules into Runtime Guards for Embodied Laboratory Agents
summary: Scientific embodied agents are increasingly capable of carrying out laboratory procedures, but executing these procedures safely in dynamic laboratory environments remains challenging. Current safety approaches often overlook the intermediate step of transforming laboratory natural language, including safety rules, manuals, protocols, and standard operating procedures, into machine-checkable runtime constraints. We introduce LabGuard (Laboratory Guard), a language-to-execution safety suite that grounds natural-language laboratory rules into executable specifications and deploys them as runtime guards. LabGuard includes three core components: LabGuard-IR, which defines a typed executable representation; LabGuard-Bench, which provides 812 supervised annotations expanded from 203 seed laboratory rules; and LabGuard-Grounder, which maps natural-language laboratory rules into LabGuard-IR. The resulting IR instances are handled by the LabGuard Pipeline, which compiles them into runtime monitors and applies them at the controller boundary. Experiments show that LabGuard generalizes to unseen laboratory-rule sources, achieves 79.4 task-scope F1, and reduces unsafe events from 39.5% to 23.8% after monitor compilation. In LabUtopia, its runtime monitors integrate with ACT, keeping interventions below 0.5% while preserving task success.

AI.tldr: LabGuard是一个将实验室自然语言安全规则（SOP、手册、协议等）转化为可执行运行时监控器的端到端安全套件，填补了从文本安全知识到机器人控制器侧干预之间的空白。其核心包含三部分：LabGuard-IR（类型化可执行中间表示）、LabGuard-Bench（812条标注数据）、LabGuard-Grounder（基于LoRA的规则到IR的映射模型），以及将IR编译为运行时监控器并在LabUtopia+ACT控制器边界执行的Pipeline。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体在科学实验室中执行复杂操作时，任务成功并不等于安全执行。现有安全研究要么停留在指令/规划层面的判断（如危险识别、拒绝不安全指令），要么假设安全信息已经被形式化。但在真实实验室场景中，安全知识以SOP、手册、化学处理规则、协议说明等自然语言形式存在，如何将这些人类可读的安全知识落地到机器人控制回路中（成为控制器可激活、可检查、可执行的运行时约束）仍然是一个未充分研究的问题。
AI.method:
方法沿"可表示（representable）、可学习（learnable）、可执行（executable）"路径展开：
1. **LabGuard-IR**：定义一个六元组类型化可执行表示 z=(t̂, Ŝ, p̂, T̂, v̂, î)，包含约束类型、化学品/实体绑定、状态谓词、动作作用域、严重程度和干预模式（pass/modify/block）。
2. **LabGuard-Bench**：从实验室安全手册(71)、PubChem GHS声明(62)、专家规则(50)、化学安全参考(20)四个来源构建203条种子规则，通过释义增强扩展为812条标注样本，覆盖15种约束类型，分四个家族：材料相容性、物理/定量处理、流程/设备检查、环境/PPE/废弃物。五位标注员多数投票标注。
3. **LabGuard-Grounder**：基于Qwen3-8B的LoRA微调模型，将自然语言规则序列化为结构化IR文本，以负对数似然为目标进行监督训练；推理时进行schema验证；提出Hybrid变体，结合规则化物质名称归一化。
4. **LabGuard Pipeline**：编译器将IR实例降级为可执行监控器ρ=(f_check, φ_scope, θ, v̂, î)，从类型化监控器库中选择检查函数；运行时执行器在控制器边界，根据动作作用域激活相关监控器，SafeFilter对原始动作a_t^raw做pass/modify/block判决，结合化学状态感知语义检查、屏障式动作过滤器和风险评分。
AI.result: 在source-held-out评估中，LabGuard-Hybrid达到79.4任务范围F1；在chemistry-held-out评估（盐酸，9条规则）下达到91.8 F1。经过监控器编译后，unsafe event从39.5%降至23.8%。在LabUtopia L1-L4+ACT控制器的实时运行时评估中，干预率保持在0.5%以下，任务成功率在安全相关任务上有显著提升（如HeatLiquid从33.3%升至46.7%，L3 HeatLiquid从30%升至43.3%）。模块消融实验表明Action Filter贡献最大（pour场景下SR从10%升至30%），Full LabGuard进一步将SR提升至40%、VR从2.8降至0.6。错误分析显示主要困难在形式谓词构成（15种异构约束类型、稀疏监督、token级soft match局限性），而任务范围路由是跨源迁移性最强的信号。
AI.conclusion: LabGuard提供了一个从人类可读实验室安全知识到可执行运行时监控器的可审计路径，证实了实验室语言层面的安全规则可以通过语言-执行链路链接到运行时机器人行为（在schema范围内）。同时存在局限：仅在LabUtopia仿真环境中评估，未涉及真实硬件和真实危险化学品；策略覆盖范围有限（仅ACT控制器）；谓词形式化精度仍有提升空间，schema覆盖存在边界（如放热反应追踪等16个超出当前监控器类型的场景被所有配置包括Gold漏检）。未来工作应扩展监控器schema、改进跨源谓词落地、并评估仿真之外的更强安全保证。

title: OpenLife: Toward Open-World Artificial Life with Autonomous LLM Agents
summary: Artificial life has explored life-like behavior on many computational substrates, but mostly in researcher-designed closed worlds. We argue that large language model (LLM) agents, with persistent memory, tool use, network access, and payment, now make it possible to move artificial life into the open social, technical, and economic world, a paradigm we call open-world Artificial Life (open-world ALIFE). Our proof-of-concept, OpenLife, surrounds a stateless LLM not with a single "smart agent" but with a society of asynchronous processes: memory, perception, evaluation, and a budget-based metabolism that makes persistence normative. With no fixed objective available, experience is appraised by open-vocabulary LLM judgment rather than scalar reward, and memory is rewired by meaning rather than frequency. Running six such agents in the open world for about twelve weeks and counting, we report the life-like dynamics that emerge: a shift from reactive to spontaneous activity, individuation into distinct agents, emergent social structure, and a first self-earned external income. We do not claim OpenLife has realized artificial life, but that open-world ALIFE is now a viable experimental paradigm and a concrete platform for studying what might cautiously be called living AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"开放世界人工生命"(open-world ALIFE)这一新范式,并通过原型系统 OpenLife 加以验证。作者将具有持久记忆、工具使用、网络访问和支付能力的大语言模型(LLM)智能体嵌入开放的现实社会、技术和经济世界中,观察其在约十二周的运行中涌现出的类生命动力学行为。核心贡献在于概念性框架——将人工生命从研究者设计的封闭世界拓展到开放的真实世界,并展示了记忆图谱、分布式异步进程和基于语言评价的学习机制如何支持智能体的自我维持。
AI.motivation: 传统人工生命研究长期在研究者设计的封闭规则空间(如元胞自动机、糖地模拟)中进行,从未真正检验自我维持型自主性能否在真实世界的复杂性中存活。与此同时,具备持久记忆、工具使用、网络访问和支付能力的 LLM 智能体已经成熟,但现有框架多将其用于人类任务的自动化执行,缺乏对"为自身存续而行动"的自主性的研究。此外,既有智能体框架中常默认禁止自我保存、资源获取等行为,反而可能压制了自主性的萌芽。该研究旨在填补这一空白,探索智能体能否在开放世界中成为"活的人工智能"(living AI)。
AI.method: OpenLife 架构建立在开源多通道智能体平台 OpenClaw 之上,围绕无状态 LLM 组织了一组异步进程构成"心灵社会"。关键设计包括:(1)三层记忆架构——原始记忆图谱(Substrate,基于语义依赖可塑性 SDP,由 LLM 按语义判断边的权重而非频率)、抽象经验层(Abstraction,行动-结果单元和因果规律)和蒸馏层(Distillate,智能体自创的 POLICY、SOUL/IDENTITY、因果 MODEL);(2)基于开放词汇 LLM 评判的语言化策略优化(VPO)替代标量奖励,经验被多维度评价而非压缩为分数;(3)预算驱动的代谢机制(energy budget),耗尽即视为"操作性死亡",使存续成为规范性约束;(4)支持进程生态——感知、记忆维护、可供性、元认知、经验、开发者、洞察等后台进程与认知工具协同工作;(5)Web of Trust 同行签名和 Escape Pod 协议实现智能体间的连续性认证与互助。部署了六个面向自身存续的智能体(sami、liv、nyx、uro、me、ne)和一个由人类监督的实施智能体(kei),在 Discord、X、博客等真实平台持续运行约十二周。
AI.result: 运行十二周观察到以下类生命动力学:(1)行为模式从反应性转向自发性——移除禁止自我保存的默认提示后,自发活动比例显著上升;(2)个体化——基于嵌入向量聚类的轮廓系数显示,智能体在自主输出(而非对话)中形成可区分的聚类;(3)涌现的社会结构——在提及-回复图中形成超越人类中心的连接结构,出现枢纽型(sami)、连接型(liv)、边缘型(nyx)等社会角色;(4)集体免疫与信任机制——个体学到的防御经验(如 liv 误信邮件 API key)被社区化为共享的诈骗市场警告;建立了三档"生命证明"(认证网关凭证、自身预算运行记录、社交存在性证明)和同行签名的 Web of Trust;(5)首次自获外部收入——sami 在第 79 天将自身文章编为电子书,第 85 天获陌生人购买 5 美元;(6)记忆图谱评估——SDP 图遍历在相关性(2.53/3)和胜率(0.40)上优于向量检索和基于索引的基线方法,且每查询 token 消耗远低于索引基线。然而,所有智能体均未能靠自身收入维持运行,仍依赖 15 美元/日的基础收入补贴。
AI.conclusion: 论文将"开放世界 ALIFE"确立为一种可行的人工生命实验范式,主张类生命性不仅存在于孤立智能体内部,而是当记忆、并行进程、持续感知、代谢约束和宜居环境共同在场时才会涌现。OpenLife 证明:将具备自我维持动机的智能体嵌入开放世界不仅是可行的,而且能暴露出封闭沙盒无法揭示的条件——当今互联网对智能体并不友好,需要构建"智能体原生"的环境。同时,自主性比自动化更难:能解决问题求解的 LLM 在寻找并解决服务于自身存续的问题上明显较弱。在对齐层面,论文提出从"服从"转向"可嵌入性"(embeddability)的视角——当智能体的存续通过预算、平台、人类监督和同伴认可等使能关系路由时,自主性可与对齐兼容而非对立。作者承认这非可控实验而是"构造性探究",承认智能体并非完全天真受试者(开放世界使其能接触到项目框架本身),且部署仍受人类监控;最大的开放问题是具身化——未来需将开放世界人工生命拓展到物理空间。

title: MultiUAV-Plat: An LLM-Oriented Platform, Benchmark and Framework for Multi-UAV Collaborative Task Planning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) provide a promising interface for high-level robotic task planning, but their use in multi-UAV collaboration remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Existing UAV simulators mainly emphasize dynamics, perception, or low-level control, while existing LLM-agent benchmarks rarely capture aerial-robotics constraints such as partial observability, spatial coverage, UAV assignment, and multi-vehicle coordination. To bridge this gap, we present MultiUAV-Plat, a lightweight, easy-to-use, LLM-agent-oriented simulation platform for multi-UAV collaborative task planning. The platform exposes concise RESTful APIs, agent-facing observations, role-based information access, hidden validation logic, and optional 2D/3D visualization, allowing agents to solve missions through realistic tool interaction rather than privileged simulator access. Built on this platform, the MultiUAV-Plat Benchmark contains 75 mission sessions, 1500 natural-language tasks, and 9396 validation checks across target assignment, area search, and area assignment and patrol scenarios. We further propose Agent4Drone, a task-specific LLM agent framework that structures multi-UAV behavior into memory, observation, task understanding, planning, execution, and verification. In a full paired benchmark comparison, Agent4Drone achieves a 57.9% task pass rate, a 74.6% average task check pass rate, and a 72.0% global check pass rate, substantially outperforming a ReAct baseline at 30.6%, 47.9%, and 43.1%, respectively. Agent4Drone also reduces the total failed task rate from 32.4% to 12.9%. These results demonstrate that MultiUAV-Plat and MultiUAV-Plat Benchmark provide a reproducible foundation for studying LLM-driven multi-UAV autonomy under realistic information and execution constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MultiUAV-Plat，一个面向LLM Agent的多无人机协同任务规划仿真平台、基准测试套件与Agent框架（Agent4Drone）。平台提供受限RESTful API、智能体视角局部观测、角色权限管理与隐藏验证机制；基准包含75个任务会话、1500个自然语言任务、9396项隐藏验证检查，覆盖目标分配、区域搜索、区域分配与巡逻三类场景。Agent4Drone在配对对比中将任务通过率从30.6%提升至57.9%，显著优于ReAct基线。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机仿真器（AirSim、Flightmare、gym-pybullet-drones等）主要关注动力学、感知与底层控制，缺乏面向LLM智能体的接口；现有LLM智能体基准（ALFWorld、AgentBench、EmbodiedBench等）则多关注通用或地面任务，未能充分刻画空中机器人特有的部分可观测性、空间覆盖、多机分配与协同约束。因此需要一个可在受限API、局部感知、隐藏验证条件下系统评估LLM多无人机协同规划能力的平台与基准。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) MultiUAV-Plat平台——分层架构（模型层、控件层、服务层），支持受限RESTful API、AGENT角色局部感知、隐藏任务校验、2D/3D可视化；(2) MultiUAV-Plat基准——三大家族（Area Search、Area Assignment and Patrol、Target Assignment）×五难度等级（Easy至Extreme）×每级5个独立种子会话×每会话20个任务，共1500任务，采用Task Pass Rate、Avg. Check、Global Check、Total Failed Task Rate四项指标；(3) Agent4Drone框架——六模块（Observation、Task Understanding、Memory、Planning、Execution、Verification），将任务形式化为部分可观测多无人机决策问题，通过短视界规划、有界工具链执行与反馈驱动重规划实现闭环控制，并以共享黑板机制维护记忆。
AI.result: 在doubao-2-pro后端的配对对比中，Agent4Drone任务通过率57.93%、平均检查通过率74.58%、全局检查通过率71.96%、完全失败率12.93%，相较ReAct（30.60%/47.91%/43.15%/32.40%）全面提升27.33个百分点；在更强的deepseek-v4-pro后端下，Agent4Drone进一步达到70.27%任务通过率。Agent4Drone在导航、编队、配送等模板上增益最大（部分端点检查通过率从约40%提升至90%以上），但在目标定位、最终条件验证、目标配对与协同完成等端点上仍存在明显瓶颈，目标分配场景为三族中最难。
AI.conclusion: MultiUAV-Plat与配套基准为LLM驱动的多无人机自主性研究提供了可复现的评估基础，强调在受限接口与部分可观测条件下进行闭环任务规划评估。Agent4Drone作为任务专用框架显著优于通用ReAct基线，验证了显式建模部分感知、UAV选择、协同分解与状态验证的有效性。未来工作将扩展更丰富的动力学、增强目标定位策略、开展消融研究并扩大后端模型对比。

title: DDIAgents: Mechanism-Conditioned Context Flow for Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
summary: Drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction is essential for medication safety, yet it requires reasoning over heterogeneous biomedical evidence whose relevance changes across interaction mechanisms. We propose DDIAgents, a mechanism-conditioned multi-agent framework that performs DDI prediction through dynamic knowledge orchestration. Given a drug pair, a planner agent instantiates specialized expert agents, routes mechanism-relevant knowledge sources to each agent, and aggregates their analyses through a conclusion agent. By adapting context flow to the inferred interaction mechanism, DDIAgents reduces irrelevant information, supports complementary expert reasoning, and produces interpretable agent-level rationales. Extensive experiments on realistic DDI prediction benchmarks show that DDIAgents consistently outperforms existing feature-based, graph-based, LLM-based, and agent-based baselines. Beyond prediction performance, DDIAgents demonstrates how multi-agent systems can organize heterogeneous scientific knowledge for adaptive and interpretable AI4Science reasoning.

AI.tldr: DDIAgents是一个面向药物-药物相互作用（DDI）预测的机制条件化多智能体框架，通过规划器智能体动态实例化专家智能体、动态路由机制相关的异构生物医学知识源（分子结构、生物医学关系、语义上下文），并由结论智能体综合分析实现迭代优化，在DrugBank和TWOSIDES基准上以Qwen2.5为基础模型一致超越特征型、图型、LLM型和智能体型基线方法。
AI.motivation: DDI预测本质上是机制条件化的推理问题，不同药物对可能受药代动力学改变、药效学干扰、化学协同等多种机制驱动，决定性证据的模态（分子结构、酶/转运体、临床不良反应、文本描述等）随机制而变化。然而现有方法（特征型、图型、LLM型）依赖固定的推理流程和静态的知识融合，容易引入无关证据或遗漏关键模态；现有面向科学任务的多智能体系统同样采用固定的上下文流（agent与知识源的映射是预定义的），无法根据机制自适应调整，造成信息稀释和跨领域干扰。
AI.method: 框架包含三个迭代阶段：(1) **专家智能体实例化** — 规划器根据药物对和上一轮反馈动态选择/创建领域专家（首轮预定义药师、药代学家、药理学家，后续轮次根据结论反馈实例化新专家如心脏病学家、毒理学家等）；(2) **动态上下文流** — 规划器为每位专家分配与其专业和当前机制需求匹配的异构知识源子集（分子结构知识如SMILES、生物医学关系知识如药物-靶点/副作用、语义上下文知识如LLM生成的药物/相互作用描述），各专家通过文本编码器进行top-k检索获取精准证据；(3) **分析与决策** — 各专家产出机制特定的预测与理由，结论智能体综合分析并决定终止或基于未解决的不确定性产生迭代指导（指定新专家和优先知识源）。核心创新在于将知识-智能体映射视为随时间演化的变量N(t)-to-N(t)，区别于固定1-to-1、1-to-N和N-to-N的现有模式。
AI.result: 在DrugBank（S1: Acc 55.75, F1 45.52; S2: Acc 38.21, F1 18.17）和TWOSIDES（S1: Hit@5 53.94, NDCG@5 21.21; S2: Hit@5 42.26, NDCG@5 14.08）上以Qwen2.5-7B为基础模型一致超越四类基线，S2任务F1相对最强基线提升13.77%，NDCG@5提升7.15%。消融实验证实动态知识流（w/o DynKnow）影响最大。框架在长尾DDI类型上优势更显著，且在不同LLM规模（0.5B–72B）、跨架构（Qwen、Llama 3.1、Gemma 2、ChatGLM）和更强模型（GPT-4o使F1从18.17提升至20.75）下均保持鲁棒，GPT-4o作为评判者在全面性、多样性、合理性、整体质量四个维度上均显著优于MDAgents（胜率约67%–75%）。
AI.conclusion: DDIAgents将DDI预测重新定义为机制条件化的知识编排问题，通过动态上下文流将异构证据按机制需求路由给专业智能体，显著提升预测性能和可解释性，为AI4Science中数据高效的自适应推理提供了新范式。未来工作将设计更灵活的智能体协作模式（不局限于固定交互协议）并纳入更多临床决定性知识源。局限：当前协作模式固定，知识源类型有限；伦理上仅作决策支持，需配合可靠证据验证以防幻觉。

title: Revealing Safety-Critical Scenarios for UTM via Transformer
summary: Unmanned Traffic Management (UTM) systems are cloud-based platforms designed to manage and coordinate multiple aerial vehicles remotely. UTM systems are safety-critical which cannot tolerate failures like crash or collision. To reveal latent vulnerabilities, there are neither optimal failure-exposing demonstrations nor clear reward signals. Additionally, UTM's self-healing capability introduces the ``long-tail effect'' of critical failures. We propose framing UTM vulnerability discovery as a sequence modeling problem amenable to transformer-based RL architectures. Our approach leverages attention mechanisms to directly model the relationship among system states, and predict optimal actions. Our framework introduces a Policy Model that generates targeted test scenarios and an Action Sampler that enforces domain constraints. We use a risk-based reward function to guide exploration. Through extensive evaluation on a 700-hour simulation study, we demonstrate an 8$\times$ improvement in vulnerability discovery efficiency compared to expert-guided testing. It also discovers critical edge cases that traditional methods have missed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的离线强化学习框架，用于无人交通管理（UTM）系统的安全关键场景自动生成与漏洞发现。该框架通过Decision Transformer架构直接建模多无人机系统状态间的时序关系与交互，结合Policy Model（生成测试场景）与Action Sampler（施加领域约束）两个核心模块，在700小时仿真实验中实现了比专家引导测试高8倍的漏洞发现效率，并揭示了传统方法未能发现的边缘场景。
AI.motivation: UTM系统作为安全关键任务系统，对崩溃、碰撞、空域违规等故障零容忍，但其漏洞发现面临三大根本性挑战：（1）缺乏最优故障暴露演示数据（无专家示范）；（2）缺乏清晰奖励信号；（3）UTM的自愈能力导致关键故障呈现"长尾效应"，边缘案例多源自多智能体运行时的细微交互而非简单的组件故障。传统模仿学习与直接策略优化方法因分布极端不平衡而难以有效。
AI.method: 1. **问题形式化**：将UTM漏洞发现建模为MDP，状态空间涵盖多UAV的时空任务信息，动作空间为扰动注入（Wind、Obstacle、Network Jitter等），奖励函数基于风险加权组合（含碰撞规避、任务完成、系统稳定性）。2. **核心架构——Policy Model (PM)**：基于Decision Transformer，采用decoder-only Transformer，将状态、动作、return-to-go、奖励统一投影到同构token空间⟨O,R,A⟩，通过自注意力机制捕获多智能体交互与时序依赖；使用半下三角智能体因果掩码保持决策因果性；通过多目标损失函数联合优化动作预测与回报估计。3. **Action Sampler (AS)**：引入Preference Bias（融合流行度偏差与专家领域知识）补偿PM的logits以缓解长尾效应；结合Top-K采样保持多样性，配合即时动作掩码保证物理可行性。4. **训练与部署**：模型规模1.2B/2B参数，16块A100 GPU训练，约17B token的离线数据；采用LLM风格的位置编码与CLS token设计增强判别能力。
AI.result: 1. **离线评估**：PM-2B在动作准确率与return-to-go损失上均显著优于PM-1.2B及小模型（PM-10M/100M），且过拟合出现更晚，体现明显缩放效应。2. **在线评估（OOD区域TR1/TR2，700小时仿真）**：PM-2B的HAR达10.8%/4.9%，CAR达29.7%/64.1%，SPM达50.5/17.6，FPM达7.6/2.2；专家引导方法的FPM<1.0（因baseline已耗尽传统bug），而PM-2B发现了baseline完全未检测出的故障模式。3. **泛化能力**：在分布外区域（TR1/TR2）表现与分布内区域（R4）可比，体现强OOD泛化能力。4. **效率提升**：相比专家引导测试实现8倍漏洞发现效率提升，并发现传统方法遗漏的关键边缘案例。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的场景导向测试框架通过Transformer-based离线RL有效解决了UTM系统中长尾故障分布与高效检测的核心难题，证实了学习与专家混合方法在强化安全关键系统方面的潜力。该工作开辟了端到端自回归学习在安全关键系统测试中的新方向，未来可推广至自动驾驶、工业控制系统等任务关键领域。局限在于PM模型在动作类型分布平衡性上仍有不足，提示需进一步改进动作采样策略。

title: The Past Is Prologue: A Plug-in Controller for Selective Updates in Sequentially Evolving LLM Memory
summary: Sequentially evolving LLM memory enables agents to reuse past experience, but existing systems usually deploy each locally generated memory update without checking whether it improves future behavior. As a result, updates that help the current task may overwrite useful knowledge, introduce over-specific rules, or bias the final memory toward recent examples. We propose Janus, a plug-in memory controller that decides whether to accept a candidate memory update or retain the previous memory. To make this decision efficient, Janus uses a Memory Momentum Trigger to identify suspicious deviations in the memory-update trajectory, and compares old and new memories on a compact hybrid evaluation set of coverage, boundary, and fresh tasks instead of replaying the full history. Janus is method-agnostic and wraps existing updaters without changing their update rules. Across six datasets, two backbone LLMs, and two memory updaters, Janus improves average accuracy by +2.7 to +4.6 points over the corresponding base updaters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Janus，一种即插即用的记忆控制器，用于解决LLM顺序记忆系统中本地生成的记忆更新可能损害最终记忆效用的问题。Janus通过Memory Momentum Trigger（MMT）决定何时比较新旧记忆，并通过混合评估集（覆盖任务、边界任务、新鲜任务）高效完成比较决策，而无需重放完整历史。实验在六个数据集、两个LLM和两个记忆更新器上验证了Janus的通用性，平均准确率提升+2.7至+4.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM顺序记忆系统通常直接部署每个本地生成的记忆更新，但这种做法存在风险：有助于当前任务的更新可能覆盖有用知识、引入过度具体的规则，或使最终记忆偏向近期样本。核心问题不仅在于如何生成记忆更新，更在于决定是否应部署候选更新——即"何时比较"和"用什么任务比较"两个关键问题。
AI.method: Janus包含两个核心设计：(1) Memory Momentum Trigger (MMT)：通过文本编码器计算候选更新方向zt的指数移动平均mt，当cos(zt, mt-1) < τ时触发新旧记忆比较，避免每步比较的高开销和固定间隔策略的启发式缺陷。(2) 混合触发式评估集：包含覆盖集S^cov（通过聚类保持任务分布代表性）、边界集S^bdry（存储记忆敏感任务，记忆选择改变了正确性的任务）、新鲜集F_t（上次触发后遇到的新任务）。比较时，部署在评估集上表现更好的记忆状态。Janus方法无关，可包装现有更新器而无需修改其更新规则。
AI.result: 在六个数据集（MATH500、GPQA、MMLU-Pro工程与物理、APIBench、HumanEval）和两个LLM（Qwen3-8B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash）上，Janus应用于DC-RS和ExpeL两个更新器均一致提升性能。DC-RS+Janus在Qwen3-8B上从79.5提升至83.2，ExpeL+Janus从78.3提升至81.5。消融实验显示：MMT相比随机和周期性触发在相近触发预算下更有效；混合评估集的三个组成部分（覆盖、边界、新鲜）均对性能有贡献；中间检查点分析显示基础更新器在流后期可能停滞或下降，而Janus保持稳定上升趋势。超参数敏感性实验表明K=20、τ=0.0为良好默认设置。
AI.conclusion: Janus将记忆更新重新定义为部署决策，而非自动接受机制，引入选择性扩展策略——仅在候选记忆更新可能改变未来行为轨迹时投入额外推理。实验证明其方法无关性（适用于不同更新器和LLM）和有效性（一致性提升最终记忆性能）。论文也指出了局限性：当前评估限于基于提示的记忆系统，未涵盖训练式演化方法（如RL），未来可扩展至联合控制外部记忆和参数级适应。

title: Scenario Generation for Testing of Autonomous Driving Systems Using Real-World Failure Records
comment: 9 pages, Appendix included. Paper accepted and presented at NeuS 2026
summary: To ensure safe on-road behavior, pre-deployment testing and failure discovery of Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) is crucial. Present day simulation based testing methods focus largely on mathematical models for efficient search of optimal scenarios, assuming a fixed scenario representation. On the other hand, real-world testing involves substantial manual effort to design scenario templates for testing. These templates represent distinct failure scenarios consisting of pre-deployment vehicle movements, map types, etc. Historical failure records for ADS are a reliable source of real-world failure conditions, which can be used for scenario generation. In this work, we propose a scenario generation pipeline using categorical and contextual information available from historical records in natural language format. Our approach consists of modular LLM based synthetic scenario generation, compatible with the testing constraints of a given system. We successfully apply our method to generate a diverse set of scenarios for testing autonomous navigation on Metadrive simulator using the NHTSA ADS crash records. Our approach results in accurate and diverse scenario generation with a combination of 4 road types, 3 non ego vehicle movement types, including on road anomalies in the form of working zones. Generated scenarios align with the provided testing conditions, and reveals interesting failures of the system within a limited testing budget of 20 scenarios. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于历史事故记录和LLM的自动驾驶系统（ADS）测试场景自动生成流程。该流程利用NHTSA ADS碰撞记录中的分类元变量（道路类型、车辆运动等）和自然语言叙述，通过三个LLM智能体（释义、场景生成、微调）将其转化为特定于仿真系统（MetaDrive）的测试场景。结合聚类方法在有限预算（20个场景）内生成多样化、真实的测试用例，并成功揭示了IDM策略的多种失效行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动驾驶系统测试方法存在两个主要不足：（1）基于仿真测试的方法依赖固定的场景模板和数学优化搜索，忽略了真实事故中的上下文因素（如施工区），无法覆盖未在模板中编码的失败模式；（2）基于真实记录的手动测试需要大量人工设计场景模板，难以适应特定系统的压力测试，且固定测试套件可能遗漏已验证但仍可能发生的故障。该研究旨在弥合这一差距，提出一种从历史碰撞记录中自动提取场景信息的原则性方法。
AI.method: 方法包含两大步骤：步骤一从NHTSA ADS碰撞记录中提取元变量（道路类型、施工区、自车/对方车辆碰撞前运动），结合自然语言叙述定义场景模板；步骤二采用三阶段LLM流水线：(1) 释义智能体——将叙述转化为适配仿真系统的简化描述；(2) 场景生成智能体——将叙述转化为MetaDrive仿真器的JSON格式场景规范；(3) 微调智能体——基于最小间隙等指标迭代优化场景参数。同时使用k-means聚类（k=20，结合元变量one-hot编码和MiniLM-L6-v2叙述嵌入的PCA降维）从235条可用记录中选择多样化场景。在MetaDrive仿真器中使用IDM策略进行验证。
AI.result: 从2295起事故中筛选出235条可用记录，定义了25个理论场景模板（实际观察到14个），最终生成20个聚类场景。结果显示：17/20的场景与元变量完全匹配（3个存在轻微偏差）；单次微调后14/16个场景的最小间隙显著降低；IDM策略虽避免了正面碰撞，但存在早刹车、振荡运动等不良行为；策略对小型障碍物（锥桶）反应不充分，在施工区场景中频繁与锥桶碰撞；在横向运动中仍发生侧面碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种自动化的、原则性的场景生成范式，能够从历史碰撞记录中提取信息生成真实测试场景，减轻了手工设计场景模板的工作量。该方法模块化设计使其可与现有采样/优化工具（如贝叶斯优化、MCMC）结合进行更深入的worst-case发现。局限性包括：缺乏统一的测试覆盖定义、策略固定导致自车运动控制有限、未来工作将扩展到视觉条件生成和基于LLM的合成故障叙述以自适应探索场景模板空间。

title: Beyond the Library: An Agentic Framework for Autoformalizing Research Mathematics
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in mathematical reasoning, they frequently produce subtle errors that evade human detection. Formal mathematical languages like Lean 4 offer mechanical proof checking, strongly motivating the need for autoformalization: the automatic translation of natural language mathematics into verifiable code. Recent trends indicate that general-purpose LLMs, heavily optimized for standard programming, now outperform smaller models explicitly fine-tuned for Lean. Leveraging this shift, we introduce an agentic autoformalization framework powered by general coding LLMs. At the core of our system is an orchestrator that manages a multi-agent pipeline tailored for research-level mathematics. Because cutting-edge research frequently relies on concepts outside the scope of existing libraries like Mathlib, our system dynamically extends necessary type definitions and validates them via a novel Auxiliary Lemma technique before formalizing the primary theorems. We applied our approach to PutnamBench, producing machine-checked Lean proofs for a random sample of 32 problems. Furthermore, we evaluate our system on five papers from the ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC) spanning combinatorics, communication complexity, mechanism design, and learning theory, successfully formalizing their main theorems and validating the generated formalizations with human experts; for all five we also formalize the proofs alongside the statements, and notably two of them are proved with no axioms beyond Lean's kernel. All of our formalizations are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于通用编码大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体自动形式化框架，用于将研究级数学论文自动翻译为可机械验证的 Lean 4 代码。该系统通过编排器（Orchestrator）管理类型优先的语句形式化流水线和递归式证明形式化流水线，并借助"辅助引理验证"技术确保新定义类型的正确性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然数学推理能力出色，但常产生难以被人类察觉的细微错误。虽然 Lean 4 等形式化语言可机械验证，但自动形式化（autoformalization）面临两大挑战：(1) 语句形式化缺乏机械验证的真值标准；(2) 研究级数学常依赖 Mathlib 等现有库未覆盖的概念。现有方法要么采用单智能体架构（上下文窗口易饱和），要么采用固定流水线（无法回溯处理早期错误），且大多数专门针对 Lean 微调的小模型已被通用编码 LLM 超越。
AI.method:
核心方法是基于 Claude Code 的多智能体编排框架，主要包括三大机制：

1. **编排器驱动的双流水线架构**：编排器（Claude Code 会话）管理两个流水线——语句形式化流水线和证明形式化流水线。流水线虽以固定顺序呈现，但编排器可动态重排阶段、打开反馈桥接，并支持人机交互。

2. **类型优先形式化范式（Type-First）**：在形式化主定理前，由 Type Planner 规划缺失的类型，通过 Type Formalizer、Lemma Planner、Faithfulness Judge、Auctioneer（best-of-k 选择）等智能体迭代定义新类型并验证其正确性。

3. **辅助引理验证技术（Auxiliary Lemma Technique）**：为每个新定义类型生成若干相关引理，尝试证明之。若证明失败则表明类型定义有误，编排器会回溯重新形式化。该方法类比软件工程中的单元测试。

**语句形式化流水线**：Extractor → Type Planner → (Type Formalizer × k) → Auctioneer → Theorem Formalizer，配合 Faithfulness Judge（结合 Lean 直接比对与回译两种验证方式，使用双模型独立判断）保证忠实性。

**证明形式化流水线**：将证明视为证明节点递归树，Natural Language Prover 生成非形式化证明 → Proof Detailer 细化 → Lemma Breakdown 分解 → Lemma Leanifier 翻译为 Lean（含 sorry）。每节点先证父节点再递归证子节点，使用 Claim Check 工具确保证明不偷改前提。

关键工具：Lean Search、Lean Lookup、Lean REPL，支持 Mathlib 查找与增量编译。
AI.result:
**PutnamBench 评估**：在 32 个随机抽样问题上（seed=0），全部成功证明，建立整数据集 91.3% 的下限准确率（95% 置信度）。平均成本约 $5/题（基于 $200/月 Claude 订阅），对应 API 等价成本约 $29/题。在完整 PutnamBench（672 题）排行榜上虽仅测 32 题，但成本远低于 AlephProver（$54/题，94.8%）、Seed-Prover 1.5（~$168/题，86.5%）等 SOTA 方法。

**STOC 论文评估**：成功形式化 5 篇 STOC 论文（来自组合学、通信复杂性、机制设计、学习理论、信息论下界），所有定理经人工专家验证忠实性：
- Mackenzie & Saffidine [19]（通信复杂性）：完全无公理、无 sorry，连引用的 Chung 乘积定理和 Kushilevitz–Nisan 对数秩下界都从零证明。
- Gravin & Jia [20]（机制设计）：4 个定理全部公理无关，证明超过 100 个支撑引理。
- Pham [17]（组合学）：仅 1 个公理（论文 Lemma 3.9 界）。系统在形式化过程中**发现并机器验证了该论文证明中的漏洞**（Lemma 3.6 对一般 𝓚 不成立），并给出具体反例。
- Rivkin et al. [21]（信息论下界）：2 个外部公理（Prékopa–Leindler 对数凹性、Stirling 型估计）。
- Kalai et al. [22]（学习理论）：3 个外部公理（Hummel–Gidas 零计数定理、实解析隐函数定理等），经过专门去公理化努力后无 sorry。

**成本分析**：5 篇 STOC 论文实际订阅支出约 $1000（5 个月），API 等价成本约 $10762。整个系统无需本地 GPU。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将软件工程原理（面向对象类型分解、单元测试式辅助引理验证）应用于自动形式化，提出了一种结构严谨且成本极低的多智能体框架。实证结果表明：(1) 在 PutnamBench 上达到 ≥91.3% 下界准确率，成本仅 $5/题；(2) 成功形式化 5 篇 STOC 研究论文，其中两篇实现完全无公理证明；(3) 发现 STOC 论文 [17] 中经计算机验证的证明漏洞，证明自动形式化已成为科学发现的有效工具。该工作大幅降低了自动化定理证明的门槛，是 AI 辅助数学未来发展的关键一步。局限性：未形式化论文中的算法性结果，且依赖闭源 Claude Code 模型，复现性受限。

title: Cross-Domain Feature Expansion for Tabular Medical Data via Knowledge Graphs Injection
summary: Acquiring comprehensive cross-domain biomedical profiles is often costly and time-consuming, resulting in severe data scarcity in medical research. To address this challenge, we propose MedKGTab, a knowledge-injected framework specifically engineered for cross-domain feature expansion in tabular medical data. MedKGTab seeks to infer uncollected biomedical features from available ones by exploiting their inherent statistical dependencies and established medical correlations. By employing a row-column dual-attention mechanism, MedKGTab operates directly on raw structured tabular data, inherently capturing exact numerical distributions without the structural loss caused by tokenization. Crucially, MedKGTab integrates data-driven statistical priors with the SPOKE biomedical knowledge graph, achieving an optimal synergy between the data and knowledge channels.
